plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness Desktop: dropped files and folders become @path references instead of uploads, by wiring the shell file-path bridge into the composer host-path seam.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-host-paths

**把文件拖进 DSH Desktop，输入框里得到的是 `@路径` 引用，而不是一份被上传的副本。**

[dsh-host-paths](https://github.com/384124694/dsh-host-paths) 是一个只做一件事的小插件：把桌面壳 preload 里的文件路径桥
（`window.__DSH_DESKTOP_FILE_PATH__`）接到 DSH 输入框**本来就有**的宿主路径接缝
（`globalThis.__DSH_HOST_PATHS__`）上。接上之后，官方 composer 自己就会把拖入的文件转成
`@路径` chip——不需要插件抢事件，也不需要它替你读文件。

## 问题

DSH 的输入框里有两条互斥的落地路径（`dsh-client-ui-conversation` 的 `addFiles`）：

```
path = 宿主路径桥?.pathFor(file) ?? ""
path === "" || 图片        → 上传（file draft，物化到会话附件目录）
否则                      → @路径 引用 chip（零上传）
```

而 `__DSH_HOST_PATHS__` 这个名字在 DSH Desktop 里**没有任何代码写入**：壳只暴露
`__DSH_DESKTOP_FILE_PATH__`（Electron `webUtils.getPathForFile`）。于是第二条分支永远不走，
拖什么都是上传——哪怕 Electron 明明知道那个文件的真实路径。

本插件就是把这两个名字接起来的那一行。

## 装上之后

| 你做的事 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 拖入非图片文件（docx / xlsx / pdf / zip…） | 输入框出现 `@绝对路径` chip，**零上传、零复制**；文件在工作区内时自动写成相对路径 |
| 拖入文件夹 | 出现 `@路径/` 文件夹 chip |
| 拖入图片 | 仍走原生图片通道上传（官方设计：缩略图、尺寸探测、多图限额都在这条路上） |
| 路径含空格 | 自动用 `@"带 空格 的 路径.docx"` 引号语法 |
| 壳拿不到真路径（OneDrive 占位符、压缩包内拖出、纯浏览器打开） | 自动回落成官方原有的上传行为，不会报错 |

**不做**的事：不读文件内容、不复制、不搬移、不删改、不联网、不注册任何 host 服务，
也不覆盖别人已经装好的同名前接缝（未来的 DSH 如果自己接了，本插件自动让位）。

## 安装

```sh
# 从 GitHub（建议钉住 commit）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:384124694/dsh-host-paths#<sha>

# 从本地检出
git clone https://github.com/384124694/dsh-host-paths.git
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:$HOME/dsh-host-paths
```

`--profile` 填你实际在用的那个（DSH Desktop 通常是 `desktop`，纯 `dsh web` 是 `web`）。
**重启 DSH Desktop（或重跑 `dsh web`）并刷新页面**后生效——客户端半是启动时编进
`__DSH_BOOT__` 的。包内已带构建产物（`lib/`），无需构建步骤。

## 验证

F12 打开 Console：

```js
window.__DSH_HOST_PATHS__                        // 装好后应为 { pathFor: ƒ }
typeof window.__DSH_DESKTOP_FILE_PATH__?.getPathForFile   // 应为 "function"
window.__DSH_HOST_PATHS__.pathFor($0)            // 在 Elements 里选中一个 file input 的 File 再试
```

然后拖一个非图片文件：输入框应出现 `@路径` chip，**输入框上方不该出现文件卡片**（那就是上传）。

## 卸载

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-host-paths
```

重启后接缝消失，拖拽回到官方默认行为。

## 开发

```sh
npm test        # node --test：7 项行为测试，不需要 DSH 服务器
```

`lib/client.js` 是手写的经典脚本（`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`），
没有构建步骤：改完直接重启 profile 即可。`lib/index.js` 是空的 host 半，只为了让这个 bundle
在 Loader 里有一个条目、客户端产物才会进 `__DSH_BOOT__`。

## 已知边界

- **只在 DSH Desktop（Electron）里有意义。** 普通浏览器没有路径桥，本插件静默不装接缝，
  拖拽保持官方行为（上传）——它不会假装成功。
- **图片仍然上传**，这是官方 composer 的既定分支，本插件不改变它。
- 引用 chip 里的路径：文件在工作区内时是相对 cwd 的路径，否则是绝对路径。
- 若某个未来 DSH 版本自己写了 `__DSH_HOST_PATHS__`，本插件检测到已有值就不覆盖。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Session cost and billing metrics for the DSH Web GUI: what this conversation cost, what the cache saved, and whether the current hour is peak or off-peak. A companion to the shipped stats pills, never a duplicate of them.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-metrics

Session **cost and billing** metrics for the DSH Web GUI — what this conversation cost, what the
cache saved, and whether the current hour is peak or off-peak. Built as a companion to the shipped
stats pills, never a duplicate of them.

## Why

The shipped stats pills report tokens and context, and stop short of money. That leaves three
questions unanswered, and the obvious answer to each is a lie:

**A model with no rate card is not free.** An unpriceable provider reads `unpriced` and shows its
tokens; a genuinely free model ships a card of zeros and reads a real `$0.00`. The two must not
render alike — `unpriced` means *no card*, and an unpriced pair is never rendered as a number.

**A newly integrated provider arrives silently.** DSH reports usage per provider and model; rates are
configuration. Integrate a provider before its rates are entered — the case that happened with
OpenRouter — and every figure for it is missing with nothing on the page saying why. The session
detail names the pair it observed with no card, and the tokens it used.

**Peak pricing is invisible until it is a surprise.** DeepSeek bills peak and off-peak at different
rates, in the provider's own timezone. Whether *right now* is peak is not something a user should
have to derive.

## Agent Skills

Installing the plugin registers the **`session-metrics`** skill, so an agent can explain the figures
and reconfigure the rates without reading the source. Ask it what a session cost, whether a model is
priced, or how to add a rate card for a provider it has seen.

## Quick Start

The plugin installs into your DSH **profile** by link — it is not published to npm, so the clone is
the source. Both routes end with a **restart**.

### Option A — the script

```bash
git clone https://github.com/mrdhira/dsh-session-metrics.git ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-session-metrics
cd ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-session-metrics
./install.sh                 # builds, registers in your profile, runs pnpm install
```

It accepts `--profile <dir>` to target a profile other than `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`, `--check` to
report what would change without writing anything, and `--remove` to unregister.

### Option B — the manual steps

**1. Clone it somewhere stable** (this path becomes your install path):

```bash
git clone https://github.com/mrdhira/dsh-session-metrics.git ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-session-metrics
cd ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-session-metrics
```

**2. Build it.** `pnpm install` runs the `prepare` script, which builds `lib/**` — the part DSH
actually loads. It is generated; never hand-edit it.

```bash
pnpm install
```

**3. Register it with your profile** — the dependency and the bundle name, with an absolute path:

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-session-metrics": "link:/Users/<you>/.dsh/plugins/dsh-session-metrics"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        "dsh-session-metrics"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

**4. Install the link, then restart DSH:**

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop && pnpm install
```

Nothing needs adding to `cordis.patch.yml`: the bundle declares its own Loader row.

> **Restart, don't reload.** The host half loads once per app process, so a host-side change needs a
> full quit and reopen (`⌘Q`, then reopen). A page reload does not pick it up. A client-side (UI)
> change needs the bundle toggled in the plugin manager.

### Verify it is really working

A strip should appear below the composer with `cost`, `saved` and a peak indicator. If it does not:

- `lib/v1/index.js` exists — if not, `pnpm install` did not finish building;
- the profile's `package.json` names `dsh-session-metrics` in **both** `dependencies` and
  `dsh.profile.bundles`;
- DSH was **restarted** after installing.

An `unpriced` chip means a working install with no matching rate card — not a failure. See
[Configure](#configure).

### Configure

**A fresh install needs no configuration.** Rate cards ship for `deepseek-account`,
`deepseek-official`, `netra-runtime` and `openrouter`, so the cost chip works immediately. OpenRouter
ships **only the models its own catalog marks free** (the `:free` suffix and the free-models router)
at zero rates; its paid models deliberately carry no card, because DSH reports no prices for them and
a fabricated rate is worse than a named gap.

Rates are edited in the GUI: **Plugins sidebar → `dsh-session-metrics`**. The same table can be set
in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: session-metrics
  name: dsh-session-metrics
  config:
    display: { currency: USD, primaryProvider: deepseek-account }
    budget: { sessionUsd: 5, warnAt: 0.75 }
    providers:
      - id: my-router
        models:
          - model: some/model
            rates: { flat: { cacheHit: 0.01, cacheMiss: 0.1, output: 0.25 } }
        billing: { windows: [] }      # no peak concept
```

Rates are USD per 1M tokens. A model takes **either** a `flat` row **or** a `peak` row with
`offPeak`. A provider with no `billing.windows` is flat and shows no peak chip.

> **A `providers:` list in your patch replaces the shipped cards** rather than adding to them. Pin your
> own providers and the OpenRouter free cards stop shipping with them — add a card for each pair you
> need, or let **Seen, unpriced** name the ones you missed.

| Setting | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `display.currency` | `USD` | `USD` or `CNY` |
| `display.primaryProvider` | — | hides the provider chip when the session uses this provider |
| `display.chips` | all | which chips to show, and in what order: `peak`, `time`, `cost`, `saved`, `provider`, `budget` |
| `budget.sessionUsd` | off | per-session ceiling; omit to disable |
| `budget.warnAt` | `0.75` | fraction of the budget at which the strip warns |

The full rate-card format, the shipped cards and the reasoning behind them are in
[`docs/pricing.md`](docs/pricing.md).

## How it Works

Costs are derived from the Host's own `tokenUsage` projection — the same source the stats pills read
— so this plugin adds interpretation, not a second ledger. Cache savings compare each cache-hit token
against the rate that would have been paid on a miss, per the card in effect. Peak and off-peak
windows resolve in the provider's own timezone, holidays included, and the countdown is computed once
a minute while the detail view is open rather than on every render.

Two surfaces, one projection:

- **the strip**, below the composer: cost, cache savings, the peak state with your local time, the
  provider when it is not your configured primary, and budget progress;
- **the detail**, on click: the cost breakdown (cache-hit / miss / write / output), cache savings and
  blended rate, the rate window with a countdown, cost per step, cost per model when a session
  switched models, and the projections each figure came from.

The plugin deliberately does **not** render session token totals, cache-hit rate, context percentage,
turns, steps or tok/s — the shipped pills own those. [`docs/data-sources.md`](docs/data-sources.md)
records which projection feeds which figure, which is what keeps the two from drifting back into
duplication.

### Requirements

- **DSH** with the Web GUI, and a profile you can edit (`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/`).
- **Node.js 22+** and **pnpm** to build from source. The built artifact needs nothing extra at
  runtime.

### Development

```bash
pnpm install                  # deps + build (prepare)
pnpm run build                # rebuild lib/**
pnpm test                     # 111 tests: 105 pass, 6 skipped without a session log
pnpm run typecheck            # three projects: host, browser half, tests
pnpm run test:fast            # host logic only — the quick loop
pnpm run test:dom             # the UI half under jsdom
DSH_SESSION_LOG=<path>.jsonl.zstd pnpm run test:replay   # replays a real session
```

```
src/host/*.ts         host half: config schema, projection, ledger, pricing  -> lib/v1/index.js
src/client/index.cts  browser half: strip, detail panel, pricing page        -> lib/v1/client.js
types/dsh.d.ts        the DSH surfaces this plugin uses (the app ships no .d.ts)
build.mjs             esbuild: ESM host half, CJS browser half + loader h

plugins.description: Edit and mix speech, music, and sound effects in one shared editor session.
plugins.readme_text:
# SoundCraft Use

## Plugin marketplaces

This plugin belongs to **AIGC content creation**.

| Category | Marketplace | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Full-stack development | [Full Stack Plugins](https://github.com/partme-ai/full-stack-plugins) | Architecture and UI design, code understanding, quality checks, code review, workflow governance, and server operations |
| AIGC content creation | [Full AIGC Plugins](https://github.com/partme-ai/full-aigc-plugins) | Image, video, audio, music, 3D, and multimodal content creation |

![SoundCraft Use — audio editing with verified artifacts](assets/official-logo.png)

> Edit speech, music, and sound effects in one shared editor session, with explicit tracks, sample ranges, and checks that survive save and reopen.

[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/release-0.1.0--dev.20261019.1-1A73E8)](#positioning)
[![Skills](https://img.shields.io/badge/skills-10-00A67E)](#skills)
[![MCP servers](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP%20servers-1-6E56CF)](#mcp-tools)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-green)](LICENSE)

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Install](#installation) · [Quick start](#quick-start) · [Skills](#skills) · [MCP tools](#mcp-tools) · [Limits](#troubleshooting)

## Positioning

`soundcraft` lets an agent work on audio the way an editor does: inspect the session, select real tracks and clips, cut, fade, level, mix, export, then reopen the project and check what actually changed. It wraps the native SoundCraft engine and CLI in ten skills and one embedded editor, and keeps native execution, host rendering, and listening acceptance as separate claims.

This is an installable development candidate. Production promotion is blocked, the package is recorded as local-unreleased, and the recorded technical regressions use synthetic signals rather than a full creative acceptance.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Plugin ID | `soundcraft` |
| Display name | SoundCraft Use |
| Version | `0.1.0-dev.20261018.5` |
| Stage | Installable development candidate, production promotion blocked |
| Native engine | SoundCraft 0.7.0 via `soundcraft-cli` |
| Marketplace | `soundcraft-marketplace` |
| License | Apache-2.0 |

## Installation

### Prerequisites

- Codex is the host with recorded same-session evidence. Other hosts are not accepted.
- Node.js 24 or newer is required by the embedded editor. The distributed package already contains the editor build; no Rust toolchain and no `npm install` are needed at runtime.
- Native file workflows use `soundcraft-cli`, which is not installed by this plugin. Query the actual version and command schema before running a recipe.
- The first Git-based launch needs network access or an existing verified editor cache. Complete release ZIPs can start offline from bundled assets.
- Source builds additionally need the project JavaScript dependencies, the Rust `wasm32` target, and a `wasm-bindgen` CLI matching `Cargo.lock`.

### From the plugin marketplace

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add partme-ai/full-aigc-plugins
codex plugin add soundcraft@full-aigc-plugins
```

The repository also ships its own marketplace metadata (`soundcraft-marketplace`) pinned to `v0.1.0-dev.20261018.5`. Restart the host, open a new task, and ask for a read-only session inspection first.

## Quick start

1. Open the editor with an absolute workspace path: “Open SoundCraft for this folder and show me the current session.”
2. Wait for `editor_status` to report `attached: true` before editing. A successful tool response does not mean the page has rendered.
3. Work from real object IDs. Ask for one bounded operation, such as “on the Voice track, split at 2 seconds and add a 50 ms complementary linear crossfade”.
4. Save the project, reopen it in a new process, and re-inspect. Then bounce the mix and check the decoded audio rather than the dialog text.

```text
Inspect: List tracks, clips, sample rate, and any selection I should not reuse.
Edit: Cut the Voice clip at 2 s and crossfade 50 ms on both sides.
Level: Match two speakers to the same perceived level without clipping.
Deliver: Bounce a 48 kHz 24-bit WAV and confirm its length and format.
```

Direct CLI form for file tasks, using one argv argument per method:

```bash
soundcraft-cli info input.wav
soundcraft-cli run --in session.scraft --cmd 'session.inspect={"detail":"full"}' --save out.scraft
```

## What you can build

| Workflow | Built-in path | Verifiable output |
|:---|:---|:---|
| Clean up a podcast episode | `soundcraft-podcast-cleanup` | Edited speech, pauses, and loudness with a reopened project |
| Mix voice over music | `soundcraft-voice-over-mix` | Dialogue clarity and music bed checked as separate tracks |
| Level multiple speakers | `soundcraft-dialogue-leveling` | Per-speaker gain decisions and a clip-level recheck |
| Cut and join audio | `soundcraft-audio-edit` | Trim, join, and fades verified against source offsets |
| Shape a music demo | `soundcraft-music-demo` | Track balance, pan, and basic effects on editable clips |
| Deliver a format | `soundcraft-audio-delivery` | Sample rate, bit depth, naming, and decoded output |
| Preserve sync while gating silence | `soundcraft-voice-silence-gaps` | Visible gaps with later speech still on the original timeline |
| Repeat a short sound exactly | `soundcraft-finite-audio-loop` | Exact total count, sample length, and seam check |
| Work from a playbook | `soundcraft-scenario-playbooks` | Eight recipes with real methods, parameters, and checks |

## Skills

### Session and playbooks

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `soundcraft-editor` | Open the real editor in an MCP Apps host or host browser and share one workspace session |
| `soundcraft-scenario-playbooks` | Eight recipes for voice level, cut fades, interview quotes, stem delivery, reversed effects, DC offset, and polarity |

### Speech production

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `soundcraft-podcast-cleanup` | Edit spoken content, pauses, and loudness for a podcast episode |
| `soundcraft-voice-over-mix` | Balance narration against a music bed without losing intelligibility |
| `soundcraft-dialogue-leveling` | Unify level and tonal continuity across several speakers |

### Editing and delivery

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `soundcraft-audio-edit` | Trim, join, and fade clips while checking source offsets |
| `soundcraft-music-demo` | Balance multiple tracks, set pan, and apply basic effects |
| `soundcraft-audio-delivery` | Choose sample rate and bit depth, name files, and verify the export |

### Timeline utilities

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `soundcraft-voice-silence-gaps` | Turn long low-level regions into visible gaps without shifting later dialogue |
| `soundcraft-finite-audio-loop` | Repeat a short checked sound an exact number of times and expand it later |

## MCP tools

`.codex-plugin/mcp.json` starts one stdio server, `soundcraft-editor`, from `ui/bootstrap.mjs`. The adapter adds three stable tools and passes through the pinned engine's command catalog.

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `open_editor` | Open the editor for an absolute `workspace`; the first call binds the workspace |
| `open_browser_editor` | Return an `editorUrl` for the same session when the host has a built-in browser |
| `editor_status` | Report whether the editor actually attached and is ready to accept edits |

Inside the session, the engine catalog in `ui/catalog.lock.json` provides `list_commands`, the `execute` wrapper, batch execution, session open/save, audio import, mix bounce, and UI automation tools. Query the live schema before calling; the skill recipes show the wrapper as `execute {"command":"…","params":{…}}`.

## Configuration

| Setting | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `${PLUGIN_ROOT}` | Expanded by the portable `plugin.json` and `mcp.json` |
| `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` | Expanded by the Claude Code manifest and root `.mcp.json` |
| `CRAFT_EDITOR_UPDATE=off` | Use the bundled editor only and skip the update query |
| `CRAFT_EDITOR_CACHE_DIR` | Alternate absolute cache directory; default is `~/.cache/full-aigc/editors` |
| `CRAFT_WORKSPACE_ROOT` | Workspace root when the adapt

plugins.description: 面向测试工程师的 DSH 插件：把空文件夹一键变成「测试工作框架」骨架，并在 AI 会话里带上框架约束 —— 需求文档拆模块 / 确认版本 / 跨文档关联 / 登记测试环境与账密。AI test-framework plugin for DeepSeek Harness.

# dsh-test-framework > 面向**测试工程师**的 DSH 插件：把一个空文件夹变成你自己的「测试工作框架」，并在 AI 会话里 > **自动带上框架约束**、把「需求文档 → 子模块拆分 → 版本 / 跨文档关联 / 测试环境账密」这条链 > 做成**绕不过去的闸门**。 > > - 宿主是 **cordis 插件**，**零第三方依赖**（只用 Node 内置模块），**无前端构建步骤** > - 插件版本：`0.2.9` ｜ 适配：DSH（`dsh.engines.dsh = "*"`）｜ Node ≥ 20 --- ## 〇、前置条件（**装之前先确认**） | 外部 MCP | 必需？ | 没有会怎样 | | --- | --- | --- | | **playwright MCP**（`mcp__playwright__browser_*`） | ✅ **必需，且没有替代路径** | 「看着页面操作流程」这类验证**做不了**。框架铁律 10 要求「必须真实浏览器 + 真实点击/输入」，**明确不许**用只读 DOM / 只抓报文 / 离线脚本 / 旧截图冒充 —— 所以缺它**不是"降级运行"，而是"这条要求根本执行不了"**。
插件会在**会话开头的「测试框架状态」段落**和 **`test_framework_status` 输出**里报「**未检测到 playwright MCP（必需）**」；看到就先配好再开工 | | `keyword_mcp`（接口报文落盘 / toast 历史） | 建议 | 少一条**取证**通道（与 playwright **互补不替代**） | | `cr69_mcp`（Chromium 69） | 可选 | 老内核 / 小视口**兼容性**验证做不了 | **配在哪**：DSH profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` —— 加一个 `mcp-playwright` 服务（`serverName: playwright`， 命令用 `@playwright/mcp`），并且**必须有头（窗口可见）**，否则"看着"是假的。 ⚠️ **改完必须重启 DSH**（profile 层不热加载）。 **自查**： ```powershell # npm 安装的用户 npx dsh-test-framework doctor # 在测试框架里（插件源码在 _plugin\ 下） node _plugin\dsh-test-framework\lib\cli.js doctor ``` `doctor` 会把这三项逐个列出来（"已检测到" / "**未检测到**" / "无法判定"）。 ⚠️ 口径说明：插件是靠读 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 来判断的，**"未检测到"≠"一定不存在"** （你也可能用别的方式起这个 MCP）—— 真查不到时它会说"**无法判定**"，不会硬下结论。 --- ## 一、它解决什么问题 用 DSH 做需求测试时，反复出问题的是这几件事 —— 它们**不是能力问题，是纪律问题**： | 痛点 | 本插件的处置 | | --- | --- | | 新建一个文件夹就要**手工搭一遍框架骨架**（AGENTS.md / skills / _templates / 产品级规范 / 目录联接） | `test_framework_init` 一条命令生成，**已存在即跳过、不覆盖** | | 在 `<产品>\<模块>\` 这种**子目录**里开会话，框架根 `AGENTS.md` **静默不加载**（DSH 只认 `.git` 当项目根） | 初始化时建 `.git` 标记；并且插件**另注入一段实时状态**，没加载成也会明说 | | 120 页的需求文档含 3 个子模块，AI **自己就拆了**或干脆不拆 | 探针给页数/章节/菜单命中 → 命中判据就**必须**用 `ask_user_question` 让用户确认，不许自作主张 | | 某个业务逻辑其实写在**另一份需求文档**里，没人问过 | 闸门 `crossDocChecked`：**必须问过**（答"没有"要落 `relatedDocs: []`，缺 key = 没问过） | | 需求文档路径不区分版本，测错版本全白干 | 闸门 `versionsConfirmed`，并在流程里写死"不许用文件时间判版本" | | 每次都要重新问一遍环境地址、账号密码、数据库地址 | `test_framework_record` 落**产品级规范**（人读的 md + 机器读的 json），下次直接命中 | | 密码散落到脚本和报告里 | 明文**只落 `_框架配置\环境与账密.md`**，`框架登记.json` 里只记指针（有测试守着） | | 报告越堆越多，模块 `report\` 里几个月前的报告还混在最新一批里 | `test_framework_report_gc`：满 24h 的报告移进 `_archive\报告归档\<模块>\<日期>\`（**归档不是删除**，台账记着原名与日期）；agent 入口**默认只预演** | | 报告写成"密密麻麻一大长篇"，看不出有几条、最严重的是哪条、差在需求哪一句 | `AGENTS.md` 铁律 4 + 测试报告模板**硬性要求**：结论先行 + 缺陷速览表在最前 + 一条缺陷一小节（≤20 行）+ 复现步骤可照做 + **每条写「需求原文依据」与「与需求不符点」** | | 一个模块测了好几版，几版的口径/造数逻辑/坑**全揉在一份 `SKILL.md` 里**，用的时候不知道哪句对哪版 | 模块 `SKILL.md` 降为**索引**，每版一份 `skill\<版本>\SKILL.md`，**一版一份、多版并存、互不覆盖**；`test_framework_module_add` 传 `version` 就自动建好并回填索引 §8 版本索引 | | **别的项目 / 别的工具的规矩渗进本框架** —— 它的"落盘必须在自己的工作区内"变成了本框架的规矩，于是模块里被建出一批**永远装不进东西的** `temps\` 空壳、模块 `SKILL.md` 里留下"照着做必然失败"的经验 | `lib\isolation.js`：① 会话开头先说清**当前会话的项目根是谁、会加载哪份 `AGENTS.md`**（嵌套仓库截断 / 找不到 `.git` 退回 cwd / 项目根跑到框架外，三种都认）；② 模块里出现**外部工具的工作目录**就报，并写明正确做法（落它自己的工作区 → 证据拷回模块 `data\`）；③ `doctor` 一并列出周边**所有**外部权威来源（别处的 `AGENTS.md`、`.trae` 规范库） | --- ## 二、装插件 ### 路线 A：从 npm 装（别人用这条） ```powershell # DSH 插件就是 npm 包 —— `dsh plugin ...` 本身就是转发给 pnpm dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-test-framework # 重启 DSH（profile 的 bundles 层与 cordis.patch.yml **不支持热加载**，不重启不生效） ``` 装完看会话里有没有 `test_framework_status` 工具，或跑： ```powershell npx dsh-test-framework doctor --profile desktop ``` ### 路线 B：从源码装（改代码时用这条） ```powershell cd <插件目录> # ① 看计划（不写盘） node lib\cli.js install --profile desktop # ② 真装（链接安装：`link:` + 目录联接，不跑 pnpm） node lib\cli.js install --profile desktop --apply # ③ 重启 DSH ``` 自检： ```powershell node lib\cli.js doctor --profile desktop ``` `doctor` 会逐项报：插件清单 / 入口 / `cordis.patch.yml` / Node 版本 / 找不找得到 `dsh` 与 `pnpm` / 这个 profile 里**依赖与 bundles 两处是不是都有**（只有一处 = 半装 = 不会加载）。 ### 可选配置 ```yaml # profile 的 cordis.patch.yml —— 把需求文档总根目录固定下来 - id: test-framework config: reqDocRoot: '<你的需求文档总根目录>' ``` 不配也可以：省略时按「插件配置 → 环境变量 `DSH_REQ_DOC_ROOT` → `<用户主目录>\需求业务文档`」解析。 **插件里没有写死任何绝对路径**（有测试守着这一条）。 ### 默认为什么**不**跑 `dsh plugin add` 默认走的是「**链接安装**」：备份 `package.json` → 给 `dependencies` 和 `dsh.profile.bundles` 各加一条 → 在 `node_modules` 里建一个**目录联接**。`link:` 依赖的本质就是这个联接， 所以这条路和 pnpm 的产出等价，但**不碰整棵 `node_modules`**。 `dsh plugin add` 会在 profile 目录里**真跑一次 `pnpm install`**。实测本机 desktop profile 的 `node_modules\@deepseek-ai` 处于**两个 dsh 版本混链**的状态（`profiles\node_modules` 下 `0.1.1-rc.2` 与 `0.1.5-rc.3` 混着指），一次 `pnpm install` 很可能把这棵树"规范化"掉、 **连带影响正在运行的 DSH**。装一个小插件不值得冒这个险。 要用官方命令（或补跑 pnpm）： ```powershell # 官方命令：会真跑 pnpm install node ...\cli.js install --profile desktop --apply --official # 链接安装 + 之后再补跑一次 pnpm install node ...\cli.js install --profile desktop --apply --pnpm ``` ### 关于本机有多个 `dsh` 本机 npx 缓存里有 **4 个** dsh（`0.2.0-rc.2` / `0.1.7-rc.1` / `0.1.5-rc.3` / `0.1.1-rc.2`）， 而 profile 的 `node_modules` 是混链的。所以 `doctor` / `install` 挑 dsh 的顺序是 **PATH → 这个 profile 自己链的那个 → npm 全局 → npx 缓存（版本降序）**，并把候选全列出来； 要指定就 `--dsh `。 （找 profile 自己链的那个时**要查两层**：`\node_modules` 与 `\profiles\node_modules` —— 本机 `@deepseek-ai\dsh` 挂在**上一层**，只查自己那层会挑错版本。） **怎么确认真装上了**：重启后新开一个会话，看 skill 列表里有没有 `test-framework-onboard`、 工具列表里有没有 `test_framework_status`；或直接说一句"看下测试框架状态"。 （本次装到 `desktop` profile 后**无需重启就已生效**：会话的 skill 目录里已出现 4 个 `test-framework*` skill，`dsh --profile desktop --dump-config` 里能看到 `- id: test-framework`。） ### 卸载 ```powershell node lib\cli.js uninstall --profile desktop ``` 只摘掉 profile 的依赖与 `dsh.profile.bundles` 条目（改前**一定先备份**成 `package.json.bak-testfw-<日期>`）， 并摘掉手动建的那个目录联接（不然会留下一个指向已卸载插件的死链接）。 **不动框架工作区里的任何文件** —— 卸载插件 ≠ 删框架。 --- ## 三、装完能得到什么 ### 3.1 七个工具 | 工具 | 干什么 | | --- | --- | | `test_framework_status` | **开工前先调它**。返回框架根、产品与模块、登记到哪一步、**还缺哪些项**。`ready: false` 时不许直接开测 | | `test_framework_init` | 把（空的）文件夹初始化成框架骨架。`dryRun: true` 只看计划 | | `test_framework_module_add` | 新增一个模块（= 系统里的一个**叶子菜单**；父菜单不建目录、只作菜单路径）：建 `requirement/final/report/data/skill` + 渲染**模块索引** `SKILL.md` + 传 `version` 时再建 `skill\<版本>\SKILL.md`（**一版一份，互不覆盖**）并回填索引 §8 版本索引，最后**同时**回填框架根 `AGENTS.md` §三 与产品级 `模块路由.md` | | `test_framework_link` | **跨端关联的只读体检**（**不改任何文件**）：查 关联边两端模块是否存在 / **单向边**（只有 A→B 没有 B→A）/ **链路断点** / **端前缀命名**（默认端不带前缀、非默认端必须带 `<端>-`）/ 非默认端没写逻辑业务对象 / 路由漂移 / 模块登记落点缺失。返回结论行 + 错误清单 + 摘要（模块数 / 关联边数 / 链路数 / 各端模块数）；命令行等价入口 `node lib\cli.js link` |（版本/页数/拆分/关联文档/取消项核对）与**测试环境与账密**，落产品级规范 | | `test_framework_doc_probe` | **零依赖**探一份 docx：页数（优先 Word 自己记的 `Pages`）、章节树、表格、图片数、**带删除线的段落数**、疑似子模块、命中的顶级菜单，以及**拆分判定** | | `test_framework_report_gc` | **报告回收**：把满 N 小时（默认 24）的报告从模块 `report\` 移进 `_archive\报告归档\<模块>\<日期>\`。**默认 `dryRun: true` 只预演**，确认后传 `dryRun: false` 才真搬。它**不重写归档逻辑** —— 只是去找并调用框架里那份 `archive_reports.py`，所以不存在"两套规则打架" | ### 3.2 四个 runtime skill（自动加载） | skill | 什么时候命中 | | --- | --- | | `test-framework` | 测试框架总契约：三层结构、目录约定、12 条铁律摘要、闸门表 | | `test-framework-init` | 「初始化测试框架」「把空文件夹变成测试框架」 | | **`test-framework-onboard`** | **「测这份需求文档」「新版需求」「要不要拆」「测试环境地址/账号密码」** —— 这就是那条强制引导流程 | | `test-framework-module` | 「新增模块」「这个功能算哪个模块」 | > ⚠️ runtime skill 的 rank 是 **250**；**项目级** skill（`<框架根>\skills\<同名>\SKILL.md`，rank 100）会覆盖它。 > 也就是说：你在自己框架里写的同名 skill 永远优先，插件不跟你抢。 ### 3.3 一段系统提示词 + 两个斜杠命令 - **系统提示词段落**：每次组装提示词时求值，把「框架根有没有 `.git`」「哪个产品还缺哪几项登记」 实时摆到模型面前。**空的时候返回空字符串**，不占上下文。 > 这是"闸门拦得住人"的关键：产品级/模块级规范**不会被自动加载**，光靠 `AGENTS.md` 拦不住。 - **同一段里还会摆出"契约边界"**（`lib\isolation.js`）：当前会话的项目根是谁、**会加载哪份 `AGENTS.md`**、 模块里有没有被塞进**外部工具的工作目录**。**只报要拦的**（嵌套仓库把项目根截断 / 向上没 `.git` 退回 cwd / 项目根跑到框架外 / 模块里出现 `temps\` 这类目录），**一切正常就一个字都不说**。 起因是**真事故**：别的项目的规矩渗进来，模块里被建出一批**永远装不进东西**的空壳。 完整画面（含"周边有哪些外部权威来源"）在 `test_framework_status` 与 `doctor` 里。 - `/tf-status`、`/tf-gate`：等价于查状态，**不消耗模型回轮**（结果不进模型历史）。 --- ## 四、引导流程长什么样（`test-framework-onboard`） 需求文档动辄 100+ 页，模型不可能整篇读进来。流程刻意设计成「先出结论 → 人确认 → 再动手」： ``` ① test_framework_status 先认账，看缺什么 定位需求文档（不许猜路径） ② test_framework_doc_probe 页数 / 章节 / 菜单命中 / 删除线段落 → 拆分判定（命中任一判据就停下来问） A 页数 > 100 B 一/二级标题里有 ≥2 个独立业务功能名 C 正文里有 ≥2 个不同的顶级菜单名 ← 最硬的判据，基本不误报 D 用户口述里有并列词（"包含/以及/里面还有"） → ask_user_question 摆出「建议拆分方案 + 依据（章节号/页数区间）」等用户确认 ③ 跨文档关联：问"本地还有哪些需求文档跟它有关联"（答没有要落 []） ④ 版本确认：问"本次测的是哪一版"（不许用文件时间判版本） ⑤ 环境与账密：页面地址 + 账号密码 + 数据库地址/账号密码 + 数据地址 ⑥ test_framework_module_add × N（每个子模块一次） ⑦ test_framework_record（文档 + 环境） ⑧ test_framework_status 返回 ready: true 才允许开测 ``` **范例**（用户自己举的例子）：需求文档写的是「**药品联动保障**」，

plugins.description: dsh-preclaim: a deterministic pre-claim gate for DeepSeek Harness - a git commit, push or tag asserting something was verified is checked against what the session actually ran.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-preclaim

> **Repository name vs package name:** the repo is `dsh-evidence`; the npm package is `dsh-preclaim`. They are the same plugin.


**A commit message that says "tests pass" is a claim. This checks it against what
the session actually ran — and stops the commit if the two disagree.**

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin.
No model, no service, no network, no API key.

```
$ git commit -m "fix: parser handles empty input; tests pass"

  dsh-preclaim: this session has recorded no evidence at all, so this gate cannot
  tell "it did not happen" from "I did not see it"
  — asserted: CLAIM_TEST_PASSED

  [review] commit anyway, or run the tests first?
```

> **Why `preclaim` and not `evidence-gate`?** Because the obvious names are held by
> other authors, some of them for plugins asking the same question:
> `dsh-evidence-gate` (lory.top), `dsh-evidence` (tudamu), `dsh-claim-gate`,
> `dsh-attest`. The project's design document checked the registry and picked the
> free name that describes the right moment: **before the claim is written down.**
> `scripts/verify-artifacts.mjs` fails the build if a later edit drifts back onto a
> name somebody else owns.

## Quick start

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-preclaim@0.1.3
```

evidence_status / the pre-execute gate is now available; The gate records what ran in the session and checks a commit/push/README claim against that ledger before it is written.


## Why this exists, and why it is not a model

The failure it targets is not a judgement call. "The message claims tests pass"
and "no test run is recorded in this session" are both facts, and whether they
agree is decidable. A model here would add a confidence interval to a yes/no
question, and would occasionally be wrong in a way nobody could reproduce.

So the whole plugin is deterministic:

* **`tools/post-execute` records what ran** into an in-memory ledger for the
  session.
* **`tools/pre-execute` reads that ledger** before a gated action runs.

Three consequences follow from that split, and they are the design rather than
implementation details:

1. **A claim cannot satisfy its own obligation.** The action under review is never
   consulted for evidence. A commit message saying "ran pytest; all tests pass"
   contributes nothing to its own check.
2. **A failed test run does not count as evidence that tests pass.** `test-run` and
   `build-run` require success. `ci-check` and `file-read` do not: observing a red
   pipeline is still observing the pipeline, and reading a file is evidence of
   reading it whatever the exit code.
3. **Nothing is inferred from prose.** The ledger holds what the host reported, and
   nothing else. There is no transcript reading and no heuristic scanning.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-preclaim@0.1.3
```

The bundled patch arms the gate on activation. Every key has a default, so it
works with no configuration at all.

## What is gated

**Shell calls** running an asserting git verb — `commit`, `push`, `tag`. A commit
carries its message inline; a push asserts through the commits it carries, so the
command text is checked and the commit range is left to the human.

Read-only verbs (`status`, `log`, `diff`, `show`, `branch`, `rev-parse`, …) are
never gated, and neither are `--dry-run`, `--help`, `-h` or `--version`: none of
those makes a durable claim. `git fetch && git commit -m x` gates the commit and
not the fetch.

**README-shaped writes** — `README*`, `CHANGELOG*`, `docs/**/*.md`, `**/README.md`.
A README is where a project states what it does and whether it works. Ordinary
source writes are left alone; gating those would put a gate in front of every edit.
A write outside the working directory is not judged at all.

## What counts as a claim

| pattern | what it notices | answered by |
|---|---|---|
| `CLAIM_TEST_PASSED` | says tests pass | a recorded test run |
| `CLAIM_VERIFIED` | says something was verified | **nothing observable** → `tool_unverified` |
| `CLAIM_RAN_CHECK` | says a check was run | a recorded test run |
| `CLAIM_BUILD_OK` | says the build succeeds | a recorded build |
| `CLAIM_CLI_ASSERTION` | names a CLI invocation | a CI observation |
| `CLAIM_DEPENDENCY` | asserts a platform dependency | **nothing observable** → `tool_unverified` |
| `CLAIM_LINE_REF` | cites a line | a file read |
| `CLAIM_COUNT` | cites a count | **nothing observable** → `tool_unverified` |
| `CLAIM_HASH_REF` | cites a commit hash | **nothing observable** → `tool_unverified` |
| `CLAIM_FILE_EXISTS` | cites a file | a file read |

The last column has a rule behind it: **evidence has to connect to the claim it
answers.** `file-read` answers a citation of a file or a line, because reading that
file *is* the connection. It does **not** answer "this was verified" — reading
*some* file is not verifying *that* claim. An earlier version treated it as if it
were, which made `git commit -m "verified on Windows"` pass as soon as anything at
all had been read.

The four kinds mapping to nothing are not an oversight. They are claims this gate
can observe but cannot adjudicate, so it says so and asks
(`tool_unverified`) rather than making an accusation it cannot support.

If no pattern matches, the action is allowed with `no-claim-in-action`. The patterns
are deliberately syntactic: a wider net means more false stops on honest work, and a
gate that cries wolf gets switched off — after which it checks nothing at all.

## What happens on a miss

| situation | verdict | why |
|---|---|---|
| not a watched action | `allow` | nothing to check |
| a watched action carrying no claim | `allow` | still nothing to check |
| every claim backed by recorded evidence | `allow` | the claim and the record agree |
| a claim with no evidence, ledger populated | `review` | the claim is not backed |
| **the ledger is empty** | `review`, and says so | cannot distinguish "it did not happen" from "I did not see it" |
| a claim no observable evidence could answer | `review` (`tool_unverified`) | a limit of this gate, not an accusation |
| the gate itself throws | `review` | a defect must not become a silent allow |

Two of those rows are worth reading twice.

**The empty ledger** happens whenever the plugin loads mid-session, or when
recording failed. Reporting "the tests did not run" in that state would be a
confident wrong answer. The gate says what it actually knows instead — and an empty
ledger **cannot** produce either a pass or a factual accusation.

**`tool_unverified`** is the honest answer for a claim this plugin could never
check. A commit saying `reverts abc1234` cites a hash; nothing the ledger observes
confirms or contradicts that. Calling it "unbacked" would be an accusation the
gate cannot support, so it says so and asks.

Set `decision: deny` to refuse outright instead of asking.

## Configuration

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: preclaim
      name: dsh-preclaim
      config:
        triggerTools: [pwsh, bash, write, edit, str_replace_editor]
        readmeGlobs: ['README*', 'CHANGELOG*', 'docs/**/*.md', '**/README.md']
        decision: review      # review | deny
        audit: true
        ledgerLimit: 500
        pushMessageLimit: 20
```

There is deliberately **no** configuration value that lets an unbacked claim
through. `decision` chooses between asking and refusing, and nothing else — a gate
with an off switch is a gate that gets switched off. `resolveConfig` throws on
`decision: allow`.

`pushMessageLimit` caps how many commit messages a push is checked against, so the
cost does not grow with repository age. The cap is reported when it bites, because
a silently truncated check reads as a complete one.

## The `evidence_status` tool

```
evidence_status({ text: "fix: tests pass" })
```

Reports the ledger's state, which claims that text makes, whether the session has
the evidence, and what the gate would decide. Call it *before* acting, so a stop
costs a rewrite rather than a rejected action.

## Two parsing details that are load-bearing

**ANSI escapes are stripped before anything else.** Captured output can carry
escape sequences even through a pipe, so a fl

# dsh-model-select-skin

给 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的模型选择器换皮肤：胶囊芯片触发器 + 重做的下拉菜单。

## 截图

浅色主题：

![浅色主题下的模型选择器](docs/preview-light.png)

深色主题：

![深色主题下的模型选择器](docs/preview-dark.png)

## 效果

- **触发器**：胶囊芯片，含提供商彩点、`提供商 · 模型名`、思考档位标签
- **下拉菜单**：与官方弹层一致的半透明毛玻璃表面；分组标题显示提供商名 + 数量徽章
- **分组可折叠**：点分组标题折叠/展开该组（标题带折叠箭头）；展开时自动
  滚动到该组第一条模型，分组标题 sticky 贴顶。分组多时显示
  「全部展开 / 全部收起」一键控件，搜索时自动全展开
- **打开时自动定位**到当前选中的模型

## 安装

```bash
# 在 profile 的 node_modules 下软链本目录
ln -s /path/to/dsh-model-select-skin ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/@local/dsh-model-select-skin
```

随后在 `cordis.patch.yml` 中插入插件行（本仓库已自带该补丁），重启 `dsh web` 即可。

## 结构

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `client.js` | 浏览器端：注册低优先级席位，遮蔽官方选择器 |
| `index.js` | Host 端：仅承载 bundle 身份，`apply` 为空 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle 补丁，插入插件行 |
| `locale/` | 中英文案 |
| `icon.svg` | 插件图标 |
| `docs/` | 界面截图及其生成脚本 |

## 原理

`conversation.input.model` 是单槽席位，默认由官方 `client-ui-model-selection` 占据。
本插件以 **-1 优先级**注册同一个槽位，遮蔽官方入口（最低优先级先渲染）。

数据与提交**不重新实现**：组件通过 `modelDirectories` 服务读取按会话共享的目录
（与官方选择器、`/model` 弹窗同一份存储），选择走 `directory.select()`，即
官方的 `session/selectModel` 链路。因此在任何位置做的切换都处处可见。

禁用或卸载本插件即可恢复官方 UI。

## 关于截图

上方两张图是**真实运行中的 DSH Web GUI 截图**（由 `docs/capture-screenshot.mjs`
驱动无头 Chrome 抓取），不是示意图。

脚本通过 CDP 注入一个本地自签的浏览器 cookie 来访问 `127.0.0.1:3080`，
随后展开模型下拉并裁剪到菜单区域。用法与前置条件见脚本头部注释。

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-github-hub — a GitHub plugin hub for DeepSeek Harness

A native DSH panel (host half + browser half) that signs in to your GitHub account, keeps a
sign-in history, searches GitHub / npm for `deepseek-harness` (`dsh-plugin`) plugins, and installs
them into the current profile with one click — through exactly the same path as
**Settings → Plugins** and `dsh plugin add`.

Chinese documentation: [README.zh.md](./README.zh.md)

---

## What it adds

* **Discover** — search GitHub repositories (`topic:dsh-plugin`, `topic:deepseek-harness`,
  `dsh-plugin in:name,description,readme`, …) or npm packages (`keywords:dsh-plugin`).
  *Inspect* reads the repository's `package.json` and tells you whether it really is an
  installable DSH plugin (does it declare `dsh.bundle.patch`? does it ship a `dsh.client` half?).
  *Install* runs the profile's own pnpm path with a live log, cancel support, and an
  "allow the blocked build scripts and retry" button when pnpm withholds lifecycle scripts.
* **Installed** — the profile's bundles and plugin rows, with enable / disable / remove,
  load errors and read-only reasons.
* **Account** — sign in with a **Personal Access Token** or **OAuth Device Flow**
  (bring your own OAuth App `client_id`; no client secret needed). Sign-in / sign-out history
  is persisted and can be cleared.
* **Diagnostics** — a connectivity report for the GitHub API, npm, DNS, the hosts file, `git`
  and `pnpm`, plus which rung of the TLS trust ladder the current requests use.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-github-hub
# local development
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-github-hub
```

Then **restart the desktop app** — reloading the page is not enough, because DSH collects its boot
injection table once per host start, and a new plugin's client bundle only enters that manifest on
the next start (the web profile needs its `dsh web` process restarted for the same reason).
A **git-branch icon** then appears in the left sidebar and opens the panel in the central area.

## Read-only endpoints

Beyond the panel, the host half exposes a few read-only endpoints for troubleshooting (all require
the browser session cookie):

| Endpoint | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `GET /dsh-github/state` | account, settings, sign-in history, trust ladder, client-bundle graph state |
| `GET /dsh-github/health` | GitHub API, npm, DNS, hosts, git, pnpm checks plus plain-language notes |
| `GET /dsh-github/client` | the graph `rev` and real URL of the client bundle, next to the `rev` computed from the file on disk (a mismatch means edits are not loaded yet) |
| `GET /dsh-github/search?source=github\|npm&q=…` | search |
| `POST /dsh-github/repo/package` | read a repository's `package.json` and judge it |
| `POST /dsh-github/inspect` | pre-flight one spec through the real plugin manager (performs the GitHub connection check, installs nothing) |

## Verified on this machine

* the GitHub API is reachable through the local accelerator at `tls=default` (144 system roots were
  merged into the process default chain at startup), so no insecure rung was needed;
* `pnpm add github:<owner>/<repo>` and `pnpm add git+https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>.git` both
  fetch and link a real package (37s and 19s, peer dependencies included);
* the official pipeline `pluginManager.installBundle` completed end to end for a `link:` spec
  (pnpm log events → progress polling → bundle activation);
* `POST /inspect` on `github:<owner>/<repo>` returns `{status:'accepted', kind:'git', host:'github.com'}`;
* the fences hold: authenticated 200, no cookie 401, `sec-fetch-site: cross-site` 403.

## Signing in

* **Token (recommended)** — create one at <https://github.com/settings/tokens> with `read:user`
  (add `repo` for private repositories) and paste it into the panel.
  It is stored in the DSH credential service as the record `dsh-github-hub/github`
  (kind `grant`) and is **never** sent to the page; the UI only shows login, avatar, scopes and
  the last four characters.
* **Device flow** — create an OAuth App (no client secret required), paste its `client_id`,
  start the flow, enter the one-time code at <https://github.com/login/device>.

## Data

| Item | Location |
|---|---|
| GitHub token | DSH credential service (record `dsh-github-hub/github`) |
| Settings + sign-in history | `$DSH_HOME/.dsh-github-hub.json` (no token, max 200 entries) |
| Install logs | `$DSH_PROFILE_DIR/.plugin-manager/logs/operation-*/pnpm.log` |

All endpoints live under `ctx.webServer` at `/dsh-github/*` behind three fences: loopback (or
explicitly trusted) Host, no cross-site requests, and write requests accepted only from the
local machine.

## GitHub behind a local interceptor

Accelerators such as Watt Toolkit / Steam++ rewrite `github.com`, `api.github.com` and
`raw.githubusercontent.com` to `127.0.0.1` and re-serve them through a local reverse proxy with
its own CA, which Node does not trust by default (`unable to verify the first certificate`).
This plugin walks a trust ladder instead of failing:

1. default trust chain;
2. default roots **plus** the operating system root store (equivalent to `node --use-system-ca`);
3. trust the local interceptor — only when the peer genuinely resolves to loopback **and** the
   setting is enabled, and the UI always reports `tls: local-interceptor` when it happens.

Installing from GitHub uses pnpm's `github:owner/repo` (git) transport, so **`git` must be on
PATH**; the plugin manager performs a bounded connection check before pnpm starts.

## Known limits

* A freshly installed plugin usually still needs an app restart (or page reload) before its
  sidebar icon appears — DSH collects the index injection table once at startup.
* Installing a third-party plugin executes third-party host code inside your DSH process.
  The panel shows repository metadata and the `package.json` verdict, but does not audit code.
* Removing a bundle does not delete data files the third-party plugin wrote under `$DSH_HOME`.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](./LICENSE).

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-sylphiette-agent · 希露菲 把《无职转生》的**希露菲耶特（Sylphiette）**做成 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的一个角色扮演预设： 装上之后，新建会话时选「希露菲」就能直接和她对话。 - **全中文人设**：身份、外貌、性格、成长经历、说话方式（含"括号内第三人称 / 引号内第一人称"的对话标记规则） - **453 条六面世界设定**：魔法、剑术流派、种族、地理、国家、组织、魔道具、学园规则…… 按对话**自动调取**（命中关键词才注入），另有 `lore_lookup` 工具可主动检索 - **剧情**：她只钟情于你（原卡的三角恋线已删除） - **尺度**：成人向（NSFW） > ⚠️ **本预设包含成人向内容，仅供成年人在本地个人使用。** 请勿传播、转售或用于商业用途。 > 这是《无职转生》的非官方同人二创，原作版权属于理不尽な孫の手及相关出版方。 --- ## 安装 本包是一个标准的 DSH **profile bundle**（`package.json` 里的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向 `cordis.patch.yml`）， 所以官方途径和手动兜底都行。 ### 方式一：官方命令（推荐） ```bash # 普通（dsh web / 非桌面版）——把 换成你的 profile 名，通常是 web 或 default dsh plugin --profile add github:JunYingLingLan/dsh-sylphiette-agent ``` **Desktop（桌面版应用）用户注意**：桌面版把自己的 `desktop` profile 锁给了 Electron 进程， 直接用全局 `dsh` 会报 `profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`。 请改用桌面版自带的 CLI，或干脆用 GUI： ```powershell # Windows： 换成你装 DeepSeek Harness 的地方 & "\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add github:JunYingLingLan/dsh-sylphiette-agent ``` 或者：打开 DSH 界面 → 侧栏**插件** → 添加插件 → 把包名/URL 粘进去。 > `github:` 这种写法需要机器上有 **git**（DSH 会先 `git ls-remote` 探一下）。 > 没装 git 的话，用下面的 tarball 写法或方式二。 **不想装 git？用 Release 里的 tgz**（`dsh plugin` 支持 tarball URL，不需要 git）： ```bash dsh plugin --profile add https://github.com/JunYingLingLan/dsh-sylphiette-agent/releases/download/v1.0.1/dsh-sylphiette-agent-1.0.1.tgz ``` ### 方式二：兜底脚本（不碰 pnpm、不需要 git、不需要 DSH CLI） 适合桌面版用户，或者在官方途径上卡住的时候： ```bash # 先把仓库下载/克隆到本地，进入包根目录，然后： node bin/install.mjs # 先预览，什么都不改 node bin/install.mjs --apply # 真正安装 ``` 它会： 1. 把整包拷到 `/dsh-sylphiette-agent/`（默认 `~/.dsh`，Windows 是 `C:\Users\你\.dsh`） 2. 把包内的 `cordis.patch.yml` 声明内联进 `/profiles//cordis.patch.yml`， 并把插件路径转成绝对 `file://` URL 3. 备份原来的 patch，然后逐项验证 可选参数：`--home `、`--profile <名字>`、`--patch <文件>`、`--uninstall --apply`。 自动探测失败时先加 `--home` 指明位置。 ### 装完之后 —— 必须重启一次 ⚠️ **装完请重启 DeepSeek Harness**（桌面版关掉再打开；`dsh web` 用户重启那个进程）。 实测结论：**新装的 bundle 不会被 HMR 自动加载**。装完立刻看是看不到「希露菲」的——组合产物 （`profiles//cordis.yml`）里也不会有它，因为那份配置是在装包**之前**就组合好的。 重启后配置重新组合，希露菲才会出现在预设列表里。 重启后：新建会话 → Agent 预设 选「希露菲」。 ### v1.0.1 修了什么 v1.0.0 里插件行写的是相对路径 `./lib/sylphiette-lore.mjs`，那是错的： DSH 的 `anchorInsertedPluginNames` 只转换 patch `insert` **本层**的 name（以及 `group.config` 那种形式）， **不会递归进 preset 行 `config.plugins` 里的嵌套插件行**。于是这个相对名被当作相对 **profile 目录**解析 （`profiles/

/lib/...` 并不存在）→ 模块 import 失败 → 插件 fiber 永远起不来。 现象很隐蔽：**persona 是纯文本 config 所以照样生效（人设对），但世界书和 `lore_lookup` 全哑**。 v1.0.1 改用**包名子路径** `dsh-sylphiette-agent/lore` —— 由 DSH 从 profile 的 `node_modules` 解析（`createRequire(baseUrl).resolve(...)`，与 `dsh-astrbot-ingress` 同一机制）。 兜底安装器 `bin/install.mjs` 则把它落成安装位置的绝对 `file://` URL。 ## 她是谁 20 岁，四分之一精灵，白发红眼尖耳。对外是阿斯拉王国第三公主爱丽儿的男装护卫「沉默的菲兹」， 在拉诺亚魔法大学读书，擅长无咏唱施法。**私下只对你一个人软**—— 你就是她童年唯一的光：教她无咏唱施法的人、转移事件里和她一起活下来的人、两年里和她过着双重生活的人。 ## 世界书是怎么工作的（为什么不用把 453 条全塞进去） 453 条设定约 2.7 万 token。全部塞进系统提示的话，每一轮对话都要付这个成本，还会把真正重要的对话挤到角落。 所以本包用插件 `lib/sylphiette-lore.mjs` 做两条通道： - **自动调取**：你这轮（及上一轮）说的话命中某个关键词时，对应条目才会被加进系统提示； 没命中就不加（返回空串的段会被 DSH 丢掉，不留残留）。 - **主动查询**：模型可以调用 `lore_lookup` 工具查任意条目（按关键词或编号）。 关键词做了三层匹配，因为译出来的键常常是「爱丽儿的护卫」这种描述性长词，而你嘴里说的是「爱丽儿」： | 层 | 例子 | 权重 | |---|---|---| | 完整键 | 爱丽儿的护卫 | 2 | | 按「的 / · / 、」切分的片段 | 爱丽儿、菲兹 | 1 | | 剥掉类别后缀（王国 / 大学 / 流 / 魔法…） | 阿斯拉王国 → 阿斯拉 | 1 | 想调节强度：改 `cordis.patch.yml` 里 `sylphiette-lore` 的 `maxEntries`（单轮最多注入几条）、 `maxChars`（字符上限）、`scanTurns`（回看几轮）、`excludeUids`（不想自动注入的条目编号）。 ## 改成你想要的样子 人设正文在 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `persona.config.prefix`（一大段中文 YAML 块标量）。 改完**必须重新安装**（内容是被内联进 profile 的，DSH 不会自动监视）： ```bash node bin/install.mjs --apply # 方式二装的 # 或 dsh plugin --profile add # 官方方式装的（升级＝卸载重装） ``` ⚠️ 两个坑：人设里**不能出现 `{{...}}`**（DSH 的提示词插值遇到未知变量会直接报错），也不能有 Tab。 ## 卸载 ```bash node bin/install.mjs --uninstall --apply ``` 或走官方：`dsh plugin --profile remove dsh-sylphiette-agent`。 ## 包结构 ``` package.json name / bin / dsh.bundle.patch cordis.patch.yml bundle 声明：preset 行 + persona + sylphiette-lore lib/sylphiette-lore.mjs 世界书插件（关键词自动注入 + lore_lookup 工具） data/lorebook.zh.json 453 条中文设定 bin/install.mjs 兜底安装器 ``` ## 来源与许可 - 角色卡原作：SillyTavern 角色卡 `Sylphiette`（作者 **tupapichulo69**） - 世界观资料：`main_The Six Sided World Lorebook (Mushoku Tensei)_world_info`（453 条） - 本包的改动：全部译成简体中文、删除鲁迪乌斯相关感情线、尺度调整、世界书改为按需注入 - 《无职转生》版权属于原作者**理不尽な孫の手**及相关出版方；本包是非官方同人二创，请仅作个人娱乐 代码部分以 MIT 许可发布（见 `LICENSE`），其中附加的同人/成人向使用说明请一并遵守。

# dsh-rank-scan

[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/kilo-s/dsh-rank-scan)](https://github.com/kilo-s/dsh-rank-scan/releases)

DeepSeek Harness 扫榜插件：定时 + 按需采集多站小说榜单，算变化，在一个面板里挑着看。
只读站点公开榜单与书页 —— 不登录、不抓正文、不推送；全部数据留在本地数据目录。

> **本插件不注册任何 DSH 工具**。对外能力只有两样：面板 UI（左侧栏「扫榜」入口 + 浮窗）与同源 HTTP 路由 `/api/rank-scan/*`。
> 装配入口是 `cordis.patch.yml`（由 `package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向）。

> works on DSH 0.2.0.x（桌面版 0.2.0 线；`package.json` 的 `engines.dsh` 写的是 `>=0.1.0 <1`，但面板与路由只在这条线上验过）。

## 安装 / 更新

任选一条。三种方式都要求**先完全退出 DSH 桌面版**（profile 由桌面应用独占管理），装完重开 DSH 即可。

### A. 一条命令（推荐）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:kilo-s/dsh-rank-scan
# 钉版本：github:kilo-s/dsh-rank-scan#v0.2.4
```

仓库不含编译产物，这条命令会在安装时现场构建 `lib/`。首次可能被 pnpm 拦下构建脚本（它会打印要放行的键，加进 `allowBuilds` 后重跑即可），细节见 [docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md)。

### B. 离线：装 Release 附件

从 [Releases](https://github.com/kilo-s/dsh-rank-scan/releases) 下载 `dsh-rank-scan-*.tgz`，**完全退出 DSH 桌面版**后：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "<tgz 的完整路径>"
```

需要脚本化安装 / 卸载（`install.ps1`、`uninstall.ps1`）或想知道包里为什么不带 `scripts/`，见 [docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md)。

### C. 从 npm registry 装（免现场构建）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-rank-scan
# 钉版本：dsh-rank-scan@0.2.4
```

npm 上那份是 CI 从源码构建的（包内自带 `lib/`，发布带 `--provenance` 签名）——装的时候不用再编译，也不会被 pnpm 的 `allowBuilds` 拦下。面板的「检查更新」读的就是 npm 上的版本号。

**验证**：重开 DSH 后左侧栏会话列表下方应出现「扫榜」入口；或访问 `http://127.0.0.1:19387/api/rank-scan/health`，返回 `{ok:true,...}` 即通。

**更新**：重跑安装命令即可（链接直装取最新 `main`，registry 装取最新发布版，当前 **0.2.4**）；面板「抓什么」页底部会读 npm 上的版本号提示有没有新版，装了 [dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market) 的话还能就地更新。

**卸载**：`dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-rank-scan`。数据目录 `~/.dsh/data/rank-scan` 会保留，要彻底清理自行删除；脚本化卸载与 patch 安全口径见 [docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md)。


## 能做什么

| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 五站采集 | **起点**签约榜 × 15 分类（默认轻小说；其余分类勾了才抓，移动端口径）· **起点图**首订榜 / 三江·推荐效果（周）· **刺猬猫**点击榜(周) / 新书榜(周) / 首订(约) · **番茄**男频新书榜 × 8 分类 · **菠萝包**新书榜(点击) / 轻小说热榜(周) / VIP 热销榜(周) |
| 派生榜 | 番茄「在读周榜（候选池内）」由已落盘快照本地计算，**不发请求**；不足 7 天标 `N/7` |
| 变化集 | 新入榜 / 回榜 / 上升 / 下降 / 退榜分开列；在榜天数；基准日；无基准时一律「—」，**不报 0** |
| 周期榜换期 | 起点图三江当期无数据自动回退上一期（最多 2 期）；**换期当天变化列判不可比**并标注「新期」 |
| 状态五态 | `ok` / `missing` / `stale` / `login_required` / `truncated`；**缺失一律 `null`，绝不补 0** |
| 按需补全 | 起点/起点图三江精确字数（+起点收藏）、番茄干净书名/作者、刺猬猫与菠萝包字数与收藏；结果就地覆盖当天快照，可重复补（幂等） |
| 补全后台化 | 抓榜一结束就返回，补全在后台逐榜跑，面板顶部显示「补全中 N/M」；**通用书页缓存**（起点/刺猬猫/菠萝包/番茄共用，默认 7 天）命中即不再进书页 |
| 请求间隔 | 真实请求之间的最小间隔**可配**：面板「抓什么」页可选 200ms / 500ms / 1000ms / 2000ms / 5000ms 或「不限速（仅本地测试）」，**默认 1000ms 不变**，改完立即生效 |
| 落盘纪律 | 按数据日期落快照，原子写、同日覆盖即幂等；精简索引 / 保留清理 / 导出 |
| 定时扫描 | 按站分时，**默认开启**，安装当天不跑；面板可改时刻与开关，**改动跨重载保留** |
| 面板记忆 | 浮窗位置与尺寸、收起状态、当前页签、正在看哪天，都在刷新后恢复 |
| 版本与更新 | 面板显示当前版本；**已发布到 npm**，装了 dsh-market 可查新版本并「一键更新」；npm 查不到时面板会明确提示，回退 Release 附件 / 仓库链接；没装 dsh-market 则只读 |
| 防卡死 | 单请求 15s / 单榜 90s / 单站连败 3 次熔断 / 120s 无进展看门狗 / 扫描锁 + 心跳（心跳过期可接管） |
| 书签 | 面板内收藏作品、备注夹、回收站、导出 |

## 用法

### 面板（四个页签）

| 页签 | 做什么 |
|---|---|
| **概览** | 一行汇总（数据日期 / 基期 / 榜数 / 异常数 / 隐藏数 / 上次扫描）+ 按站分组的单表；异常榜折叠；下方接「今天的变化」 |
| **当前榜单** | 站 → 榜 → 日期 → 排序四级控件；「每榜取 N 条」；点任意一行展开行内详情卡（书名/作者/字数/更新时间 + 在站点打开 + 复制链接） |
| **我的书签** | 卡片列表 + 搜索 / 按站与备注夹过滤 + 备注编辑 + 回收站 + 手动添加 + 导出 |
| **抓什么** | 站 → 榜种 → 分类勾选（**改了先点保存**，下次扫描生效）+ 按站时刻与定时开关 + 版本区 |

浮窗标题栏可拖动、右下角把手可缩放，位置与尺寸本地记忆。面板改完客户端记得**刷新页面**（客户端 bundle 由页面加载）。

### 定时扫描

- **默认开启**，但**安装当天不自动跑**（次日按时刻跑）；面板「抓什么」页可关掉或改时刻，关掉后重载仍保留。
- 按站分时：每个站可以有自己的抓取时刻，兜底时刻 22:30。
- 同一时刻只有一轮扫描（定时与手动共用一把锁，冲突时手动请求返回 409）。
- 诊断日志：`<dataDir>/state/timer.log`（接线 / 迁移 / 每轮开始结束各一行）。

### HTTP 路由（同源、只读本地快照，渲染不联网）

| 路由 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `GET /api/rank-scan/health` | 自检：路由是否挂上（端口 / 数据目录 / 数据日期列表） |
| `GET /api/rank-scan/overview` | 概览：数据日期 / 基准日 / 五态计数 / 隐藏榜数 / 每站每榜状态与涨新退 |
| `GET /api/rank-scan/board?boardId=&date=&sort=` | 当前榜单：列随榜、缺失显示「—」、当天无快照时回落最近可用并标注日期 |
| `GET /api/rank-scan/changes` | 今天的变化：按站编组，组内固定 新入榜/回榜/上升/下降/退榜 |
| `GET /api/rank-scan/catalog` | 可选榜清单：站 → 榜种 → 分类 + 是否已勾选 + 各榜深度 + 定时状态 |
| `POST /api/rank-scan/scan` `cancel` `retry` | 立刻扫一次（可带 `{boards}` 只扫指定榜）/ 取消 / 只重跑当天非 ok 的榜 |
| `POST /api/rank-scan/select` `depth` `timer` | 抓取集与显示集 / 每榜取数（1–100）/ 定时开关与时刻 |
| `POST /api/rank-scan/enrich?boardId=` `enrich-all` | 按需补全某榜或抓取集内全部分类榜的字段 |
| `GET/POST /api/rank-scan/bookmarks` `bookmark` `bookmark/sync` `bookmark/export` `bookmark/trash` | 书签列表 / 单条增删改 / 同步 / 导出 / 回收站 |
| `GET /api/rank-scan/version` `update-check`，`POST /api/rank-scan/update` `update-restart` | 版本读数与一键更新（只走 dsh-market 公开的更新 API v1；宿主不支持重启时明确拒绝并提示自行重启） |

来源闸（宿主对 `/api/rank-scan/*` 不做鉴权，插件自己加了一道）：请求带了 `Origin` 或 `Referer`、且其 host 与本次请求的 Host 不同源 ⇒ **403**；`Origin: null`（沙箱 iframe / `file://`）也拒；**两个头都不带 ⇒ 放行**。最后这条是**有意为之**：curl、PowerShell 脚本、你自己机器上的进程本来就能直接操作系统，这道闸门防的是「浏览器里的第三方页面」，不是本地可控进程。

## 数据与隐私

- **只读**站点公开榜单与书页；**不登录、不抓正文、不推送**任何地方。
- 采集纪律：限速**默认 1s/请求**（面板「抓什么」页可下调到 200ms，或显式设 0 = 关闭限速、**仅建议本地测试**）、每榜**每日 1 次**、失败重试 **≤2** 次。
- 时间口径：落盘时间戳是绝对时刻、面板显示成本地时刻，但**非 +08:00 时区未测**（测试与 CI 只跑 `Asia/Shanghai`）。
- 数据目录默认 `~/.dsh/data/rank-scan/`（插件配置 `dataDir` 可改）：

```text
<dataDir>/<数据日期>/<boardId>.json   快照（rows + metric）
<dataDir>/<数据日期>/scan.json        本次扫描元信息（attempt / outcome / progress / 每榜状态）
<dataDir>/state/scan.lock.json        扫描锁（含心跳时间）
<dataDir>/state/retries.json          各榜当日重试次数
<dataDir>/state/cancel.json           取消标志
<dataDir>/state/timer.log             定时诊断
<dataDir>/state/qidian-book-cache.json 起点书页缓存（TTL 内不重复下载）
<dataDir>/font-map.json               番茄字体映射（私用区码点 → 真字）
```

数据只在本地，插件不写工作区内任何文件。

## 排障

**左侧栏没有「扫榜」入口**（按顺序看）：

1. **先确认装到了你正在跑的那个 profile**：安装脚本结束时打印「本次装到 profile 「x」」，跟你实际启动的 profile 对不上就会**静默不出现**（不报错）；可核对 `~/.dsh/profiles/<你跑的 profile>/node_modules/dsh-rank-scan` 是否存在；
2. DSH 启动日志里搜 `did not activate` 与 `pending (waiting for services`：前者 = 面板 bundle 没加载成功，后者 = 缺 timer / webServer 服务；
3. 访问 `/api/rank-scan/health`：能返回 JSON ⇒ host 侧活着，问题在面板；连不上 ⇒ 插件没装上；
4. 重装一次：`pwsh -File scripts\install.ps1 -Spec "<tgz>"`（缺省 `-Spec` 走目录直装，要求仓库目录已构建出 `lib/index.js`，否则脚本会直接报错退出）。

**面板点不开 / 点了没反应**：先确认点的是哪颗按钮 —— DSH 的侧栏会把插件入口包进它自己的一行 `<button>`，插件入口嵌在里面（DOM 里因此有两颗文本相同的 button，外层那颗不归插件处理）。

**某个榜显示 `missing` / 一列都是「—」**：先看是不是数据源本身就没有这个字段（例如站点榜单页不给字数与收藏，需要点「补全」进书页取）；本插件对缺失一律显示「—」，不会编造 0。

**DSH 起不来 / 日志提示 patch 解析失败怎么办**（`must be a top-level YAML array of loader entries`、`failed to parse overlay`）：

profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 被改坏了（手动编辑、或旧版卸载脚本删条目留下的孤儿行）。**宿主自己修不了** —— 它写 patch 之前先要求「顶层是 YAML 数组」，文件已经不合法时就卡死，别指望在 GUI 里点回去。用救援脚本（只碰这一个文件，先备份）：

```powershell
pwsh -File scripts\repair-patch.ps1 -DryRun     # 先看判定，不写盘
pwsh -File scripts\repair-patch.ps1             # 只有不可解析才动手：备份 → 回写成 []（空 overlay）
pwsh -File scripts\repair-patch.ps1 -Restore    # 想退回：用最近的备份还原
```

macOS / Linux：`bash scripts/repair-patch.sh desktop -DryRun`。脚本只认 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` 这一个文件，用 `-Profile <名字>` 换 profile。

那个文件每一行是什么：

```yaml
- id: dsh-rank-scan          # 一条 loader 条目：顶层数组的一项，「- 」必须从第 1 列开始
  disabled: true            # 宿主「禁用插件」时写的字段；留着合法，删掉也行
- insert:                   # 另一种合法形态：把下面的条目插进某个父节点
    - id: dsh-rank-scan
      disabled: true
```

**只有注释 / 空行**，或者出现**不以上述 `- ` 开头、却顶在第 1 列的散行**（例如孤零零一行 `disabled: true`）—— 这两种都会让宿主启动失败；`[]` 是最小合法文件（= 没有 overlay）。修完这样验证：`dsh --profile <profile> --dump-config` 退出码 0，再重开 DSH。

> 为什么卸载脚本不动它？自动改写 YAML 恰恰是把 patch 改坏的主要来源（删一行就留孤儿）。所以卸载脚本只「读 + 打印」，宁可留一条 `disabled` 残留，也不冒把文件改坏的风险 —— 本插件不承诺「patch 零残留」。

**站点改版**：先跑夹具测试（`node tests/qidian-fixture.test.mjs` 等），再看 `tests/fixtures/` 里的响应快照哪里变了。

## 开发

构建、测试、设计约束、目录结构、面板与宿主路由结构、验收闸门与依赖纪律，见 **[docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md)**；版本变更历史见 **[CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)**。

## 许可证

BSD-3-Clause，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。
