plugins.description: DSH Desktop 冷启动开机动画插件 · Arknights 风格 HUD boot sequence for DeepSeek Harness (dsh-cold-boot)
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-cold-boot · DSH 开机动画

给 **DeepSeek Harness** 的界面加一段 44 秒的冷启动演出：黑底、等宽字、扫描线与 glitch，
六场戏、四句英文人声，音效全部用 Web Audio 现场合成。纯 DOM + CSS，**零运行时依赖**，
装完下次打开就播（点画面或按任意键跳过）。

> 非官方同人作品，与 DeepSeek 官方无关。产品名与鲸鱼标识归其权利人所有 —— 见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

![开场](docs/img/1-cold-boot.png)
![标识与光扫](docs/img/2-whale-sweep.png)
![三栏全貌](docs/img/3-overview.png)
![授权通过](docs/img/4-authorization.png)
![定格名牌](docs/img/5-final-plate.png)

## 安装

| 方式 | 怎么做 |
|---|---|
| 应用内插件市场 | 在市场里搜 **dsh-cold-boot**，一键装 |
| npm | `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cold-boot`（预构建，免构建授权） |
| 本地 tgz | 下载 `dsh-cold-boot-<版本>.tgz` → DSH 的插件页「从本地文件安装」 |
| 源码 | `git clone` 后 `npm run build`（`prepare` 钩子也会自动构建），再从目录安装 |

关掉 / 只播一次（浏览器控制台）：

```js
localStorage['dsh-cold-boot'] = 'off'    // 永不播
localStorage['dsh-cold-boot'] = 'once'   // 每个标签页只播一次；删掉这个键就恢复每次开机都播
```

装完在 profile 的 `package.json` 里会多一条 `dsh.profile.bundles` 记录
（本机是 `%APPDATA%\dsh-desktop\harness\profiles\web`，`patchReload: live`，不用重启）。
想关掉就把它从 bundles 里去掉，或者直接卸载。

## 看效果（不装插件也能看）

```bash
npm run standalone     # → preview-standalone.html（1.7MB 单文件，引擎 + 四句人声全内联）
```

双击打开即可，不需要服务器、不依赖相对路径（可以随便拷给别人）。

| 控件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| ▶ 从头播 | 整段 **44 秒**跑一遍（点画面、按任意键都能跳过） |
| ⏭ 跳过 | 直接走收尾流程 |
| 时长 32s / 44s / 56s | 整段压缩或拉长，人声音高不变、语速跟着缩放 |
| 🔊 / 🔇 | 开关音效与人声（浏览器拦自动播放，点一下才有声音） |
| ① ~ ⑥ | 定格在六场戏的任意一场 |

`npm run frames 16000 34000` 会生成 `dev/frame-<ms>.html` 定格页 —— 改完时间轴先拿它逐帧核对。

## 六场戏（基准 44000ms）

| 时刻 | 场 | 画面 |
|---|---|---|
| 0–7.6s | ① | 冷启动字幕（COLD BOOT / 冷启动序列 · 逐项自检 / SEQUENCE 00）+ 日志开始打字 |
| 2.6s / 12.8s | ①③ | 人声 1「Uplink established. Terminal boot sequence initiated.」；人声 2「Self-check complete…」 |
| 8.0–12.8s | ② | 标识逐笔描线（六边形线框 → 鲸鱼 → 一道光扫掠过 → DSH 字标落下）、档案栏、幽灵编号 07 |
| 13.4–26.2s | ③ | 三栏全貌 + 标题 DEEPSEEK HARNESS + 副标题 + 代号 + 日志 18 行 + 进度条与六盏步骤灯 |
| 23.6s | ③ | 人声 3「Permission proxy armed. Session handover standing by.」 |
| 26.2–30.6s | ④ | 权限校验面板：六条 scope 逐行落（workspace-write OK / 9 industrial modules ON / MCP ONLINE / modbus write ASK / credentials LOCKED / session OK），右侧百分比推到 100 |
| 31.6–40.2s | ⑤ | 授权通过：三个同心环 + AUTHORIZATION GRANTED + 一道红细线（全片唯一的红）；33.8s 人声 4「System ready. Welcome back, Engineer.」 |
| 41.2s | ⑥ | 白闪 → 切三栏 → 41.8–44s 干净名牌停 2.2 秒 → 0.9 秒淡出，露出 DSH 界面 |

**场景层之间是先出后进**（前一块淡完才开始下一块），不会出现两块面板同时半透明。

## 里面有多少「真的是 DSH」

不是套壳文案，几个读数是对着本机实际安装抄的：

* **鲸鱼**＝ DSH 桌面端 `resources\icon.png` 里那只抠出来的，不是网上随手找的图；
* **v0.11.1**＝ `DSH Desktop.exe` 的 ProductVersion；**30 loaded**＝ profile 里 `dsh.profile.bundles` 的条数；
* 场① 第二行 `81 SKILLS · 30 PLUGINS · 9 MCP · $ dsh doctor`、场③ 的 `DSH desktop v0.11.1 · web profile`
  与 `dsh doctor` 日志行，都可以按你自己的机器改（改 `DEFAULT_LOG` / `TEXT` 常量即可）；
* 三条读数（CONTEXT / PERMISSION / TOOLS）跟着动画时间走，不是写死的静态条。

## 人声与音效

* 四句人声：**英文**，Windows SAPI（Zira，Rate −4 ≈ 比常速慢 45%）+ `scripts/voice-fx.py -ann`
  提亮到参考素材的频谱（F0 190Hz / 质心 1063Hz）。文件 `audio/en/L1..L4-zira-rm4-ann.wav`，
  实测 7.16 / 7.74 / 7.34 / 6.63 秒。**每句时长写进了 `DEFAULT_VOICE[].dur`** ——
  漏写会退回 3900ms 的假设值，就是之前「两个声音」的根因（第三句实际说到 24.87s，压上第四句）。
* 音效（`createSound()`）：低频底噪、终端 blip、glitch 噪声、白闪、收尾 chime 全部用 Web Audio
  现场合成，不带素材；音量比人声低 12~20dB，说话时自动 duck。
* 语音时刻表 2.6 / 12.8 / 23.6 / 33.8s，末句 40.4s 收，白闪 41.2s —— 每句都留 ≥800ms 余量。

## 插件形态

| 文件 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `lib/client.js` | 浏览器半边（1.7MB）：引擎 + CSS + 四句人声（base64 WAV）全内联，`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({...})` 外壳 |
| `lib/index.js` | 宿主半边（<1KB）：空实现 + 名字与版本，只为让 cordis 认得这个 bundle |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 往 profile 里插一条 `#dsh-cold-boot` |
| `icon.png` | 512×512 插件图标（同一只鲸鱼 + HUD 细框） |

宿主侧不碰任何东西（不读文件、不发请求、不注册工具），所以**权限上只要 workspace-write 就够**。
前端只用到 DSH 客户端自带的 `ctx`/`React`/`host.call`/`styles.insert`，没有额外 peer 依赖。

## 文件

| 路径 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `src/boot-animation.js` | **引擎**（唯一事实来源）：时间轴 `T`、日志/步骤/人声文案、CSS、`play()` |
| `src/client-glue.js` | 插件外壳：把引擎挂上 `window.DSHBootAnimation`，给插件半边的调用面 |
| `src/host-half.js` | 宿主半边源码（空实现） |
| `audio/en/L1..L4-zira-rm4-ann.wav` | 四句英文人声（16bit 单声道 22.05kHz） |
| `scripts/build-plugin.mjs` | 打 `lib/`（内联音频、查语法、查同步）；`--check` 只校验 |
| `scripts/build-standalone.mjs` | 打 `preview-standalone.html`（引擎 + 人声 data URI 内联） |
| `scripts/build-frames.mjs <ms...>` | 生成 `dev/frame-<ms>.html` 定格页（自检用） |
| `scripts/make-icon.py` | 用抠好的鲸鱼遮罩画插件图标 |
| `scripts/voice-fx.py` · `scripts/voice-analyze.py` | 人声染色 / 量化（numpy） |
| `docs/img/` | README 里那五张图 |

## 引擎 API

```js
var handle = DSHBootAnimation.play({
  duration: 44000,          // 整段时长；相位按比例缩放
  sound: true, volume: 0.55,
  soundBase: '', voiceBase: '',   // 装成插件后指向只读资源路由
  voice: [{ src, dur, text, meta }],
  log: [...], steps: [...], rail: [...],
  skipOnClick: true, oncePerSession: false, seek: null, onDone: fn
});
handle.finish();   // 跳过
handle.destroy();  // 立刻摘掉遮罩
```

改时间轴只需要动：相位表 `T`、步骤灯时刻 `STEP_AT`、日志 `DEFAULT_LOG`、人声 `DEFAULT_VOICE`
（CSS 里的 `--t-*` 变量与 `T` 一一对应，两处要一起改）。

## 已验证 / 已知

* 六场戏 + 结尾定格逐帧截图核对（1280×800 与 512×900 两种窗口）；量尺（`getBoundingClientRect`）
  确认窄窗下标题单行不溢出、档案栏一行一条、日志底部不被步骤灯压住。
* 实跑收尾、点击跳过、`destroy()` 三条路径都实测会摘掉 `#dsh-boot-animation` 与 `<style>`，不会留黑屏。
* 打包体积：`lib/client.js` 1.7MB → tgz **830KB**（四句人声内联占 1.2MB）。
* 踩过的坑：`animation` 是简写，**收尾的 `dsb-keep` 必须写在各元素自己的规则里**（分组规则会覆盖入场动画）；
  淡出动画只能 `forwards`，配 `both` 会在延迟到点前就按不透明显示；`inset:auto` 会把前面的
  `left/top` 一起重置，居中元素要把它写在 `left/top` **之前**。

## 许可

MIT（见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)）。人声由 Windows SAPI 合成、音效现场生成，仓库里不含任何第三方素材。

plugins.description: DSH 客户端插件：在输入框上方维护一条状态条（比输入卡片略窄、居中、与卡片上沿贴合），向其它客户端插件提供 inputStatusBar
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-status-bar 📊 **在输入框上方留一条状态条，让其它插件把「当前状态」放到它该在的地方。** [安装](#安装) · [它做什么](#它做什么) · [注册一个段](#注册一个段) · [几何是怎么定的](#几何是怎么定的) · [样式契约](#样式契约) · [已知边界](#已知边界) · [开发](#开发) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-status-bar)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-status-bar) · [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-success)](LICENSE) · ![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-plugin-4B6BFB)
![输入框上方的一条状态条：左侧是 Agent Mesh 节点状态，右侧是本插件版本](docs/demo-dark.png) DSH 的输入框上方有一条**比输入卡片略窄、居中、与卡片上沿贴合**的横条位置（宿主槽位 `conversation.input.dock`）。这个包把它做成一个**通用容器**：它自己不含任何业务逻辑、一个段都不注册， 只对外提供一个注册面，任何客户端插件都可以往里放自己的状态段。 于是"当前用的是哪台机器""插件市场有几条更新""这轮测试过了几条"这类**一直该看得见、又不值得占一段对话** 的信息，有了统一的落点——样式一致、位次不打架、主题跟着宿主走。 > 当前版本 `0.2.1` · DSH 客户端插件 · 零运行时依赖 · 对着 **DSH 0.2.0-rc.2** 核对过几何与令牌 ## 安装 ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-status-bar ``` `--profile` 填你实际在用的那个（桌面端是 `desktop`，Web 端是 `web`）。**重启 DSH 生效**—— 客户端半体是启动时加载的。 这条命令背后是 pnpm：装完包之后，它会**自动**把声明了 `dsh.bundle` 的依赖加进 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`——不用手改 `package.json`。 | 从哪装 | 命令 | | --- | --- | | npm（推荐） | `dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-status-bar` | | GitHub 最新提交（还没发版的改动） | `dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:vianvio/dsh-plugin-status-bar` | | 本地目录（改代码即时生效，用来开发） | `git clone https://github.com/vianvio/dsh-plugin-status-bar.git ~/dsh-plugin-status-bar`
`dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:$HOME/dsh-plugin-status-bar` | 以后升级、卸载： ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop update dsh-plugin-status-bar dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-plugin-status-bar ``` > **升级 DSH 大版本后状态条"消失"了？** 先看插件管理器给的那行提示。宿主 preflight 会读 > `peerDependencies` 里的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` 区间，不满足时会把整行**禁用**（不是崩，是静默缺席， > 更难查）。本包声明的是 `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`。 ## 它做什么 | 谁 | 做什么 | | --- | --- | | **本插件** | 维护那条横条：宽度/圆角/材质/贴合全部按宿主令牌算；提供 `inputStatusBar` 注册面 | | **使用方插件** | 往注册面里 `register()` 自己的段——数据驱动（容器渲染标准触发器与面板外壳）或自带组件 | - **没有段时整条容器不渲染**，不会在输入框上方留一条空壳占位。 - 段之间自动插 1px 分隔线；`align: "end"` 的段被推到横条右侧。 - 同一时刻只展开一个面板；Esc / 点击外部关闭；`↑` `↓` 在面板项之间移动焦点。 - 使用方插件被回收时，它注册的段自动注销。 ## 注册一个段 ```js // 你的客户端插件 client.js window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id: "your-plugin", factory: (require) => { var module = { exports: {} }; var exports = module.exports; var react = require("react"); function CafeSegment(props) { return react.createElement(props.Segment, { id: "cafe", open: props.open, onToggle: props.toggle, title: "咖啡", menu: props.open ? react.createElement("div", { className: "dshStatusHint" }, "面板内容") : null, menuAvailable: true }, react.createElement("span", { className: "dshStatusDot", style: { background: "#f59e0b" } }), react.createElement("span", { className: "dshStatusLabel" }, "咖啡"), react.createElement("span", { className: "dshStatusText" }, "2 杯") ); } exports.name = "your-plugin"; exports.inject = ["inputStatusBar"]; exports.apply = (ctx) => { ctx.effect(() => ctx.inputStatusBar.register({ id: "cafe", order: 120, component: CafeSegment })); }; return module.exports; } }); ``` 也可以完全走数据驱动（容器渲染标准触发器与面板外壳，你只给数据）： ```js ctx.inputStatusBar.register({ id: "market", order: 200, align: "start", // "end" 表示右对齐组 label: "插件市场", status: "3 条更新", tone: "pass", // idle | running | pass | warn | fail dot: true, menu: MarketPanel, // 组件：{ item, bar, host, close, toggle } onSelect: (api) => {}, // 无 menu 时的点击行为 }); ``` ### 注册面 API | 方法 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | `register(item)` | 注册段，返回注销函数；`id` 必填且唯一；段上限 16 | | `unregister(id)` | 按 id 注销 | | `update(id, patch)` | 浅合并更新一个段（命中返回 `true`） | | `list()` | 当前段快照（已按 `order` 升序） | | `subscribe(fn)` | 订阅变更，返回退订函数 | | `revision()` | 变更计数（调试用） | 段按 `order`（默认 100）升序排列，同序按 `id` 排序；空间不足时收缩省略 （`text-overflow: ellipsis`），不换行、不横向滚动。 拿不到 `ctx` 的集成方可以走 `window.__DSH_INPUT_STATUS_BAR__`——它和 cordis 服务指向**同一个**注册面。 ## 几何是怎么定的 尺寸不写死，全部由宿主 composer 自己的令牌推出来（宿主调版面时状态条跟着走）： | 依赖的宿主令牌 | 0.2.0-rc.2 | 用途 | | --- | --- | --- | | `--dsh-composer-side-clearance` | `16px` | 输入卡片距 composer 栈边缘的留白 | | `--dsh-composer-dock-inset` | `8px` | dock 面板相对卡片边缘的内缩单位 | | `--dsh-composer-card-max-width` | `content-width + 32px` | 输入卡片宽度上限 | | `--dsh-composer-stack-gap` | `6px` | 被负 margin 吃掉，让条体贴住卡片上沿 | | `--dsw-radius-lg` · `--dsw-specific-menu` · `--dsw-menu-backdrop-filter` | 主题提供 | 圆角、表面材质、背板滤镜 | 推导式：**相对 composer 栈边缘内缩 `side-clearance + 2 × dock-inset`**，也就是相对输入卡片边缘 内缩 `2 × dock-inset`——与宿主自己的 `GoalBar` / `QueueDock` / `TodoPanel` 在同一槽位里的落位完全一致 （它们分别用 `4 × dock-inset`、`2 × dock-inset + padding` 达到同一个效果）。 想自己调宽窄，覆盖 `--dsh-status-bar-inset` 即可（相对 composer 栈边缘，上面那套推导只作兜底）。 表面走宿主 dock 面板同一套材质，所以浅色主题下不会变成一条灰带： ![浅色主题下的同一条状态条](docs/demo-light.png) > 上面两张图不是画的：`npm run render` 把**本机 DSH 里那份真的 composer CSS 与设计令牌**抽出来排版， > 塞进插件真渲染出来的标记，再用无头 Chrome 量真实盒模型并截图——同一份产物就是那 81 条几何断言的依据。 ## 样式契约 容器外壳（由本插件渲染，段不要覆盖）： | 类名 | 用途 | | --- | --- | | `.dshStatusDockRow` | 挂载行：宽度/上限按宿主令牌推导、居中、吃掉堆叠间距贴住输入卡片 | | `.dshStatusBar` | 整条容器（`role="toolbar"`）：宿主 dock 面板材质、仅顶部圆角、接缝不描边 | | `.dshStatusSeg` / `.dshStatusSegEnd` | 段外壳（`position: relative`，面板以此为锚） | | `.dshStatusSegButton` / `.dshStatusSegStatic` | 段触发器（可点击 / 静态） | | `.dshStatusSegBody` | 段内容容器 | | `.dshStatusChevron` / `.dshStatusChevronOpen` | 面板箭头（展开旋转 180°） | | `.dshStatusPanel` | 面板外壳（向上展开、宿主菜单底色与投影） | 段内容与面板内容可直接复用的公开积木： | 类名 | 用途 | | --- | --- | | `.dshStatusDot` / `.dshStatusDotPulse` | 状态点 / 脉冲动效 | | `.dshStatusLabel` / `.dshStatusText` | 主文案 / 次要文案 | | `.dshStatusHead` / `.dshStatusBadge` | 面板标题行 / 徽标 | | `.dshStatusRow` / `.dshStatusRowLabel` / `.dshStatusRowValue` | 面板信息行（label 左、value 右） | | `.dshStatusSep` | 面板分隔线 | | `.dshStatusCell` / `.dshStatusCellValue` / `.dshStatusCellValueOk` | 面板动作项（配 `role="menuitem"`） | | `.dshStatusHint` | 面板底部说明文字 | 主题令牌：表面、圆角、描边与交互色全部走宿主 `--dsw-*` 变量并提供回退值。 | 可调变量 | 默认 | 含义 | | --- | --- | --- | | `--dsh-status-bar-inset` | `side-clearance + 2 × dock-inset` | 相对 **composer 栈**边缘的每侧内缩 | | `--dsh-status-bar-height` | `32px` | 条高 | ## 已知边界 - **只负责输入卡片上方那一条。** 卡片内部的工具行（模型选择、权限、附件）属于宿主的 `conversation.composer.dock`，本插件不碰——两边同时抢位次会让输入框抖动。 - **它是基础设施，不认识任何业务。** 段的文案、颜色语义、面板内容都由使用方决定； 本包只保证外壳、交互与主题一致。 - **容器几何依赖宿主的 `--dsh-composer-*` 令牌。** 宿主哪天改掉这些名字，宽度会退回回退值—— `npm run compat` 就是用来当场抓到这件事的。 - **`render` 需要本机装有 DSH。** 它要读 `app.asar` 里的真实 CSS 与令牌；没装会明确报错， 不会静默跳过。 ## 开发 产物就在仓根、**没有构建步骤**：`client.js` 是页面按 `

plugins.description: Codex architect and read-only reviewer for DeepSeek Harness Desktop. ChatGPT sign-in, model selection, explicit file approval and checkpoints. Preview.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Codex Architect

[English](README.en.md) · [Публикация](PUBLISHING.md) · [История изменений](CHANGELOG.md)

Плагин для **официального DeepSeek Harness Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 на Windows**. Codex проектирует архитектуру и проверяет изменения, DeepSeek выполняет основную разработку. Версия плагина: **0.2.1, предварительный выпуск**. Имя пакета npm: **dsh-codex-architect**.

В одном окне Harness доступны команда `/codex` и вкладка **Codex Bridge** в правой панели. Плагин использует установленный Codex CLI с входом через ChatGPT. OpenAI API-ключ не требуется; перехода на платный API и автоматической замены модели нет.

Версии **0.1.0 и 0.1.1** содержали ошибку активации bundle. Версия **0.1.3** исправила ошибку Windows `EBUSY` после `/codex models`. Версия **0.2.0** добавила основной интерфейс управления, а **0.2.1** исправляет загрузку списка моделей внутри песочницы DSH. Обновите пакет и перезапустите Harness.

## Установка

1. Проверьте, что установлены Harness **0.2.0-rc.2**, Git и Codex CLI; в Codex выполнен вход через ChatGPT. Подтверждённая версия CLI: **0.162.0-alpha.17.2**. Для этой alpha-версии интерфейс может измениться после обновления.
2. В Harness откройте **Plugins / Плагины**, выберите добавление пакета и укажите **`dsh-codex-architect`** (npm latest: **0.2.1**). Для точной версии: `dsh-codex-architect@0.2.1`. GitHub-источник: `github:Lanzuelo/dsh-codex-bridge#v0.2.1`. Альтернатива — скачать `.tgz` из [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Lanzuelo/dsh-codex-bridge/releases) и указать полный абсолютный путь к нему. **Имя `dsh-codex-bridge` в npm принадлежит другому проекту: не устанавливайте его как этот плагин.**
3. Дождитесь успешной активации и перезапустите Harness, если менеджер этого попросит.
4. В чате проекта введите `/codex help`. В правой панели через `+` / страницу выбора вкладок откройте **Codex Bridge**.
5. Нажмите **Загрузить модели**, выберите модель и сохраните её. Можно выбрать одну модель для всех ролей, отдельную для каждой роли или ввести ID вручную. `default` означает штатный default Codex с изолированной конфигурацией запуска.

Если Desktop не видит CLI в PATH, плагин ищет `codex.exe` в `%USERPROFILE%\AppData\Local\OpenAI\Codex\bin\<версия>`. При нестандартной установке укажите `codexPath` в конфигурации строки плагина. Относительный исполняемый скрипт `.cmd` не запускается через shell; предпочтителен абсолютный путь к `codex.exe`.

Пример конфигурации строки плагина в пользовательском patch профиля, **если строка уже существует, измените её, а не добавляйте дубликат**:

```yaml
- id: codex-bridge
  name: dsh-codex-architect
  config:
    codexPath: 'C:\Users\USERNAME\AppData\Local\OpenAI\Codex\bin\VERSION\codex.exe'
    # Необязательно: отдельное локальное хранилище вне каталога проекта.
    stateDirectory: 'C:\Users\USERNAME\.dsh-codex-bridge'
    timeoutMs: 600000
    maxAttempts: 3
```

Установка в рабочий профиль пользователя в рамках разработки не выполнялась. Сначала рекомендуется проверить пакет в отдельном профиле. Обновление Harness требует повторной проверки совместимости; не обходите ограничение версии.

## Основной маршрут в интерфейсе

Откройте вкладку **Codex Bridge** и выберите режим:

- **DeepSeek** — передать идею или исправления DeepSeek без запуска Codex;
- **Codex** — поручить Codex план, предложение файлов или исправление;
- **Codex → DeepSeek** — Codex проектирует и проверяет, DeepSeek реализует и
  исправляет.

Панель показывает текущий этап, последние задания и одноимённые действия:
**Построить план**, **Проверить проект**, **Исправить в DeepSeek**,
**Подготовить в Codex**, **Показать предложение**, **Применить**,
**Восстановить**, **Повторить** и **Остановить**. ID и slash-команды находятся
в технических деталях.

## Новый проект через команды

```text
/codex plan Создай Telegram-бота с PostgreSQL
/codex handoff <id плана>
```

`plan` предлагает до трёх вариантов без записи файлов. `handoff` без дополнительного текста передаёт рекомендуемый вариант DeepSeek для реализации. В режиме Codex панель позволяет выбрать вариант и подготовить содержимое файлов; только отдельное подтверждение `apply` записывает предложение.

В скелете обязательны `docs/architecture.md` и `docs/deepseek-handoff.md`. Существующий `AGENTS.md` может войти в контекст как соглашения проекта; плагин **не создаёт и не перезаписывает** `AGENTS.md`, чтобы не конфликтовать с пользовательскими инструкциями. Для существующего проекта используется тот же `plan`; изменения исходного стека требуют явного запроса.

## Ревью и исправления

```text
/codex review
/codex review focus Проверь особенно обработку повреждённых данных
/codex review files src/auth.ts|src/auth.test.ts --focus валидация
/codex handoff <id ревью>
/codex fix <id ревью>
```

Без путей ревью охватывает staged и unstaged изменения относительно HEAD, удаления и untracked файлы. Без Git плагин проверяет ограниченный безопасный снимок всего проекта и отмечает отсутствие baseline как ограничение. Также передаются основные manifests, архитектурные документы и до 12 локальных зависимостей JS/TS. Если Git-репозиторий находится выше рабочего каталога, выберите его корень. Путь с пробелами допустим; разделитель нескольких путей — `|`.

Ревью возвращает severity, file, line/end_line, evidence, explanation, proposed_fix, confidence, summary и handoff. Тесты и сборка при этом не запускаются. Отчёт относится к сохранённому снимку кода, а не к будущим изменениям. Исключения и ограничения контекста доступны через `show`.

Пользователь сразу выбирает исполнителя. Обе команды принимают содержательный `incomplete`-отчёт с конкретными findings и не требуют шаблонного текста:

```text
/codex handoff <id ревью>
/codex fix <id ревью>
/codex show <id предложения исправлений>
/codex apply <id предложения исправлений> <код подтверждения>
```

`handoff` передаёт замечания DeepSeek со стандартной задачей исправить их и выполнить проверки. `fix` просит Codex подготовить изменения без записи. Дополнительный текст после ID остаётся необязательным уточнением.

## Модели, квоты и отмена

```text
/codex models
/codex model all gpt-5.6-sol
/codex model architect default
/codex model review <поддерживаемый ID>
/codex model fix <поддерживаемый ID>
/codex status
/codex cancel
/codex retry <id задания>
```

Каталог получается только по запросу через документированный `model/list` app-server; сами задания выполняются через `exec`. Каталог не зашит в код. ID `gpt-5.6-sol` вернулся локальным каталогом и прошёл один минимальный запрос во время разработки; это не обещание его будущей доступности.

Если модель недоступна, плагин предупреждает и оставляет выбранный ID; пользователь выбирает другую модель и запускает `retry`. При квоте сохраняется снимок задания, новые запросы блокируются, автоматических повторов и API fallback нет. `retry` — явное решение повторить, со свежим снимком и текущей моделью роли; по умолчанию максимум три попытки одного задания.

DeepSeek не запускается плагином автоматически. `handoff` — явное решение передать результат и продолжить работу, в том числе после квоты Codex. Обычные сообщения и другие плагины Harness находятся вне управления Bridge. Отмена останавливает принадлежащий плагину процесс; таймаут по умолчанию — десять минут.

## Контрольные точки и ограничения

Перед записью сохраняются оригинальные байты всех заменяемых файлов и журнал операции. Изменённые пользователем после снимка файлы не перезаписываются. Откат выполняется явно:

```text
/codex restore <id предложения> <код подтверждения>
```

Откат откажется затирать поздние правки. После сбоя в процессе применения используйте тот же `restore`; оригиналы остаются в `checkpoint-<id>.json`. Не удаляйте это хранилище до завершения восстановления. Откат удаляет только новые файлы предложения и пустые каталоги, созданные этой операцией. Это локальная файловая контрольная точка, без git commit/reset и без изменения Git index.

- Все запросы Codex выполняются с `read-only`, без пользовательского config, с отключённым web search и shell-функциями, из временного каталога вне проекта. Входные исходники передаются ограниченным снимком; исходный каталог не используется как cwd процесса. Изоляция чтения не равнозначна О

plugins.description: GitHub repository sync plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): bidirectional git sync with pre-push checks, Actions/CI monitoring, repo add/remove/rename, local file browsing.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-github-sync

DSH 插件：GitHub 仓库自动双向同步 + Actions/CI 流水线 + 本地推送前检查。同一套能力同时暴露给 **Agent 工具**、**Web 面板**和**定时器**。

## 功能

| 能力 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 双向同步 | fetch → 计算 ahead/behind → 并入远端（快进 / merge / rebase，冲突即回滚）→ 跑推送前检查 → push |
| 冲突策略 | `report`（默认，只报告不动手）/ `merge` / `rebase` / `prefer-remote` / `prefer-local`；任何冲突都会 abort 并回滚，绝不留半合并状态 |
| 推送前检查 | `checks` 列表（shell 命令），`onFail: block`（阻止推送）或 `warn`（记一笔继续） |
| Actions/CI | 自动补 `.github/workflows/dsh-ci.yml`（缺失时创建）、`workflow_dispatch` 触发、轮询 run 到完成、查看 runs/checks/status |
| 工作流 | 列出 workflows、按 ref 分发触发（支持 inputs） |
| 通知 | 同步/流水线事件按 `notifyOn` 过滤，经 `agent.followup()` 唤醒 agent |
| Web 面板 | 侧栏 "GitHub Sync" 面板：仓库卡片、状态、CI runs、一键 同步/流水线/触发CI/补CI文件、**文件浏览器**、**全部仓库列表 + 一键加入同步/手动添加/移除**，15s 自动刷新 |
| 仓库管理 | 全部仓库（`/user/repos`，需 PAT，缓存 5 分钟）；「加入同步」自动克隆到 `cloneRoot/<owner>/<name>`（可指定本地路径；已是 git 仓库的路径直接注册）；运行时加入的仓库持久化在状态文件，「移除」只出列表、不动磁盘 |
| 改名同步 | 面板/工具改名 → GitHub `PATCH /repos`（需 admin）+ 本地 `git remote set-url`；配置仓库的改名记在状态文件的映射里（不改 cordis.patch.yml），运行时仓库直接改条目；历史/CI 缓存跟随新名 |
| 活跃置顶 | 按「未提交改动(+1000) + 顶层文件最新 mtime(权重100) + 最近提交(权重60)」的时近度阶梯分排序，活跃仓库自动排前面；卡片显示「使用中 / N 分钟前」徽章 |
| Actions 详情 | 卡片「Actions 运行」区：最近 runs 列表 → 点开某次 run → jobs 与每一步（step）的结论；带 ↗ GitHub 跳转 |
| 本地文件 | 卡片「本地文件」区：直接读本地克隆磁盘（不走 GitHub、不需 PAT），目录/文件树 + 文本预览（≤128 KB，二进制只给元数据）；路径被约束在仓库根内（`path-escape` 防护） |
| Agent 工具 | `github_sync` / `github_status` / `github_ci`（runs/checks/status/**run-detail**）/ `github_workflow` / `github_repos`（list/add/remove/**rename**）/ `github_files`（**source: local(默认)/github**） |
| 定时 | `intervalMinutes` 周期自动同步全部仓库；`runOnStart` 启动即跑一次 |

## 安装

零运行时依赖，直接从 GitHub 安装（需要 dsh 自带 pnpm）：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add https://github.com/wzw4429-crypto/dsh-github-sync
```

发到 npm 之后也可以用包名安装：`dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-github-sync`。安装后**重启 dsh** 生效。

## 配置放在哪里

包内的 [cordis.patch.yml](cordis.patch.yml) **只声明插件行、不带任何配置**；你的 token、仓库列表、定时周期等写在 **profile 自己的 patch 层**（`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`），按 `id` + 模块名覆盖：

```yaml
- id: github-sync
  name: dsh-github-sync
  config:
    token: 'ghp_...'
    repos:
      - name: my-repo
        path: D:\path\to\repo
```

这样密钥与机器路径不会进插件仓库，插件升级也不会覆盖你的配置。面板/工具运行时「加入同步」的仓库存在状态文件里，无需改配置。

## 认证（PAT）

两种方式，二选一（`token` 优先）：

1. **环境变量（推荐）**：设置 `GITHUB_TOKEN=<PAT>`（或改 `tokenEnv` 指向别的变量名）。PAT 需要 `repo` 权限（私库）和 `workflow` 权限（触发 Actions / 写 workflow 文件）。
2. **配置直填**：`config.token: '<PAT>'`。

token 绝不会出现在日志、工具输出、面板或错误消息里（`redactedConfig` 脱敏）；git 的 fetch/push 通过 **env 注入** `http.extraheader` 使用 PAT（不进进程参数），无 token 或非 github.com https 远端时回退系统凭据助手/SSH 密钥。

## 配置项（profile patch 层的 `github-sync.config`）

```yaml
- id: github-sync
  name: 'dsh-github-sync'
  config:
    enabled: true            # 总开关
    runOnStart: false        # 启动 5s 后先跑一轮
    intervalMinutes: 30      # 定时周期
    tokenEnv: 'GITHUB_TOKEN'
    notifyAgent: true
    notifyOn: [conflict, error, checks, pipeline]   # 事件：conflict/error/checks/pipeline/pull/push
    autoCommit: false        # 同步前把脏工作树自动提交（否则脏树需并入时报 dirty）
    conflictPolicy: 'report' # report/merge/rebase/prefer-remote/prefer-local
    onCheckFailure: 'block'  # 检查未单独声明 onFail 时的默认：block/warn
    repos:
      - name: my-repo
        path: D:\path\to\repo
        remote: origin        # 默认 origin
        branch: ''            # 默认当前分支
        mode: bidirectional   # bidirectional/pull/push
        githubRepo: ''        # 可选显式 owner/name；缺省从 remote URL 推断
        workflowFile: ''      # 可选，补 CI 文件名，默认 .github/workflows/dsh-ci.yml
        checks:
          - name: test
            run: 'npm test'
            onFail: block     # block/warn
    pipeline:
      triggerCi: true         # 同步后 dispatch CI
      waitCi: true            # 轮询到 run 完成
      waitTimeoutMinutes: 10
      pollIntervalSeconds: 20
```

## 状态与数据

- 状态文件：`<profile>/github-sync-state.json`（每仓库 `lastSync` / `lastPipeline` / `history`（尾 20 条）/ `ci` 缓存）。
- 同步语义：`up-to-date` / `pulled` / `pushed` / `synced` 为成功；`dirty` / `diverged-report` / `conflict` / `checks-blocked` 为安全停住（工作树与 HEAD 不受损）；`error` 为 git/环境失败。

## 开发

```powershell
# 语法检查 + 测试（35 项：config/state/checks/真实 git 同步 10 场景/github mock/pipeline/tools/host 冒烟/本地浏览防穿越/活跃度/改名/setRemoteUrl）
node --test test/run-tests.mjs
```

状态文件里的 `"codeGen": N` 是已加载代码的代号指纹：改完代码重启 dsh 后该值应更新，用于自检新代码是否生效。

## 环境要求

- dsh（DeepSeek Harness）能加载 bundle，自带 pnpm 与 Node
- Node ≥ 20（仅本地开发/测试需要）
- `git` 在 PATH 中；需要 GitHub API 功能（列全部仓库、Actions/CI、改名、私有库）时配置 PAT，仅做公开库拉取可以不用

## 许可证

MIT

plugins.description: Design and restructure interfaces while keeping an editable FigCraft document.
plugins.readme_text:
# FigCraft Use

## Plugin marketplaces

This plugin belongs to **AIGC content creation**.

| Category | Marketplace | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Full-stack development | [Full Stack Plugins](https://github.com/partme-ai/full-stack-plugins) | Architecture and UI design, code understanding, quality checks, code review, workflow governance, and server operations |
| AIGC content creation | [Full AIGC Plugins](https://github.com/partme-ai/full-aigc-plugins) | Image, video, audio, music, 3D, and multimodal content creation |

![FigCraft Use — interface design in your agent workspace](assets/official-logo.png)

> Design, restructure and hand off an interface inside your agent host, with the editable FigCraft document and its tokens kept as the source of truth.

[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/release-0.1.0--dev.20261019.1-1A73E8)](https://github.com/full-aigc-plugins/figcraft-plugin/releases)
[![Skills](https://img.shields.io/badge/skills-11-00A67E)](#skills)
[![MCP tools](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP%20tools-26-00A67E)](#mcp-tools)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-green)](LICENSE)

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Install](#installation) · [Quick start](#quick-start) · [Skills](#skills) · [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)

## Positioning

`figcraft` turns a page requirement into an editable interface document and carries it through design system, responsive layout, prototype and handoff. The plugin bundles a source-built FigCraft Web with same-session MCP automation and workspace file operations; it does not re-implement the design engine or claim pixel fidelity it has not checked.

| Property | Value |
| :--- | :--- |
| Plugin ID | `figcraft` |
| Version | `0.1.0-dev.20261018.3` |
| Status | Development preview; all-host acceptance still open |
| Editor runtime | Node.js 24, started from `ui/bootstrap.mjs` |
| Editor baseline | FigCraft `v0.6.0` fixed source plus this plugin's automation build |
| Optional CLI | `figcraft-cli`, used by recipe scripts as `--cli` |
| License | Apache-2.0 |

## Installation

### Prerequisites

- Node.js 24 on `PATH`; the bundled stdio MCP server runs on it.
- Network access on the first editor launch. The plugin downloads and verifies the pinned editor archive; a complete release ZIP already contains it, so no Rust toolchain and no `npm install` are required.
- `python3` on `PATH` only if you run the optional recipe scripts that ship with four skills.
- `figcraft-cli` only if a recipe should drive the native CLI; the plugin does not install it.
- A host that supports plugins or stdio MCP. Embedded panels additionally require MCP Apps or a built-in browser.

### From the plugin marketplace

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add partme-ai/full-aigc-plugins
codex plugin add figcraft@full-aigc-plugins
```

Restart the host, open a new task, and ask FigCraft to open the editor for your workspace.

### Other host manifests

| Host | Manifest | Path base |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Agent Plugins 1.0.0 | `plugin.json`, `mcp.json` | `${PLUGIN_ROOT}` |
| Codex | `.codex-plugin/plugin.json`, `.codex-plugin/mcp.json` | plugin root relative to `cwd` |
| Claude Code | `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, `.mcp.json` | `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` |

Kimi (`kimi.plugin.json`), DeepSeek Harness (`dsh/`) and the WorkBuddy example (`hosts/workbuddy/mcp.json`) are also present. In a development checkout you must build the editor assets first; cloning the source is not an installed runtime.

## Quick start

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[Install plugin] --> B[Restart and open a task]
    B --> C[open_editor]
    C --> D{editor_status ready?}
    D -->|No| C
    D -->|Yes| E[create_node / set_properties]
    E --> F[inspect_document / get_node]
    F --> G[save_file]
    G --> H[export]
```

1. Open the editor with an explicit `workspace` argument.
2. Build the first frame with `create_node`, then style it with `set_properties`; complex structures go through `run_command` or `batch`.
3. Read `inspect_document` for structure and `screenshot` for the actual image.
4. Save with `save_file`, reopen with `open_file`, and confirm the layers are still editable.
5. Export for handoff only after the reopened document matches what you approved.

## What you can build

| Workflow | Built-in path | Verifiable output |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Low-fidelity wireframe | `figcraft-wireframe` | Structured frames and blocks, no invented content |
| Design system with variables | `figcraft-design-system` | Component library, states, colour and text variables |
| Light and dark token card | `figcraft-light-dark-token-card` | Semantic aliases with CSS or JSON delivery |
| Responsive layout | `figcraft-responsive-layout` | Auto-layout frames with wrap and overflow handled |
| Clickable prototype | `figcraft-prototype-flow` | Pages connected with entry, back and overlay states |
| Import an existing Figma file | `figcraft-import-fig` | Imported nodes plus a loss report for fonts and images |
| Editable chart | `figcraft-signed-bar-chart` | Positive, negative and zero values as editable bars |
| Swappable icon button | `figcraft-swappable-icon-button` | Instance swap and boolean visibility, text kept separate |
| Developer handoff | `figcraft-dev-handoff` | Annotations, measurements, CSS or React references |

## Skills

| Skill | What it does |
| :--- | :--- |
| `figcraft-editor` | Open FigCraft in the host, check same-session MCP, diagnose workspace save |
| `figcraft-wireframe` | Turn a page requirement into a low-fidelity wireframe or first interface |
| `figcraft-responsive-layout` | Mobile, tablet and desktop adaptation, auto layout, wrap and overflow |
| `figcraft-design-system` | Component library, button states, colour and text variables, light/dark themes |
| `figcraft-prototype-flow` | Connect pages into a clickable prototype with entry and overlay states |
| `figcraft-import-fig` | Import Figma `.fig`, REST file JSON or SVG and report fidelity loss |
| `figcraft-dev-handoff` | Editable UI, annotations, assets and CSS or React references |
| `figcraft-scenario-playbooks` | Recipes for login, plan card, metric component, navigation, container, dialog, empty and error states |
| `figcraft-light-dark-token-card` | Light/dark theme and semantic colour tokens with real command bindings |
| `figcraft-swappable-icon-button` | Icon swap plus hideable icon, with return-ID binding and re-check |
| `figcraft-signed-bar-chart` | Editable bars including positive, negative and zero values |

Skills come from the independent `figcraft-skills` source and are pinned by `scenario-candidates.json` with per-skill SHA-256 digests.

## MCP tools

One bundled server, `figcraft-editor`, speaking **stdio**. The local HTTP listener only serves the editor page and its same-session bridge. The catalogue exposes 26 tools: 21 agent-callable tools and 5 `_editor_*` bridge tools the panel uses internally.

| Family | Tools | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Session | `open_editor`, `open_browser_editor`, `editor_status` | Open the editor and confirm that it attached |
| Discovery | `list_commands` | List live command IDs, parameters and enabled state |
| Command gateway | `run_command`, `batch` | Run one command, or an ordered batch |
| Authoring | `create_node`, `set_properties` | Create nodes and set their properties, returning IDs |
| Inspection | `inspect_document`, `get_node`, `inspect_ui` | Document tree, one node, and interface state |
| Selection and input | `select`, `pointer`, `key`, `type_text` | Select objects and drive the same input paths as a user |
| Files | `open_file`, `save_file`, `export`, `screenshot` | Open, save, export and capture the canvas |
| History | `undo`, `redo` | Step back and forward one change |

## Configuration

| Setting | Where | Effect |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `workspace` argument | `open_editor` / `open_browser_editor` | Binds the task folder; paths outside it are refused |
| `CRAFT_EDITOR_UPDATE=off` | stdio MCP `env` | Use the bundled editor only; no download attempt |
| `CRAFT_EDITOR_CACHE_DIR` | Environment | Absolute directory for verified editor archives |
| `CRAFT_WORK

plugins.description: Run Python on the local CUDA GPU from DeepSeek Harness: device status, foreground and detached jobs, durable logs, and a measured peak-VRAM figure per run. / 在 DSH 里直接跑本地 GPU 的 Python 任务：设备状态、前台/后台作业、日志与峰值显存统计。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-cuda

Run Python on your local NVIDIA GPU from **DeepSeek Harness**.

Three tools plus one skill, so an agent can do numerical work on the GPU instead of
occupying the CPU: device status, foreground and detached runs, durable logs, and a
measured peak-VRAM figure for every run.

> 中文说明见 [README.zh.md](README.zh.md).

## What you get

| Name | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `cuda_status` | device memory, utilization, GPU processes, every CUDA-capable Python on the machine, recent jobs |
| `cuda_run` | submit Python source (`code=`) or a `.py` file (`script=`, plus `args=`); foreground or `background=true` |
| `cuda_job` | follow one job: `logs` / `wait` / `kill` / `info`, by exact id, unique prefix, or `latest` |
| skill `cuda-compute` | the local terrain, how to write the code, the traps — loaded on demand by the model |

Every run gets its own directory under `~/.dsh/gpu-runs/<job-id>/`:

```
script.py        a copy of what actually ran
_runner.py       the wrapper that records resource facts
stdout.log       full stdout (the tool returns only a tail)
stderr.log       full stderr
job.json         the durable record: pid, cwd, argv, timestamps, status
result.json      written by the wrapper: ok, exit_code, elapsed_s, peak VRAM
```

`peak_alloc_MB` comes from `torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated()` inside the child, so the
number is measured, not estimated. A program can read `DSH_CUDA_JOB_DIR` to write its own
artifacts there — they are listed back to the model automatically.

## Five design decisions worth knowing

1. **Exceeding the foreground budget promotes a run to background instead of killing it.**
   A two-hour simulation should not die because the caller stopped waiting. The result comes
   back with `status: running` and a note; follow it with `cuda_job`. Only an explicit
   cancellation actually terminates.
2. **Background runs are detached** and survive a harness restart — again on purpose,
   because long compute should not be tied to a UI lifecycle. The cost is that "leftover"
   jobs are found by asking, which is what `cuda_status` is for.
3. **A detached run's outcome is settled from `result.json`.** No parent is left to record
   the exit code, so once the pid disappears the wrapper's own fact sheet decides
   `done`/`failed`; only its absence means `lost`.
4. **The skill is registered through a borrowed provider.** The catalog keeps the summary
   and every load re-reads the file, so editing the skill body needs no restart. Skill
   registration is a soft dependency: a deployment without `ctx.skills` still gets the tools.
5. **`lib/engine.js` imports nothing from DSH**, so the engine is driven directly by plain
   Node in the test suite — see below.

## Install

The package lives in a workspace directory. Install it through the harness rather than by
hand-editing the profile (the bundled `cordis-plugin-development` skill explains why):

```
plugin_manager  action: install_bundle  target: <absolute path to this directory>
```

**Bundle code is only loaded at harness startup** — restart DSH after installing or editing.
(The installer's `applied` result means the config was written and the entry imports
cleanly; it does not mean the tools are already visible to a running agent.)

## Configure

Precedence for every setting: explicit plugin config → environment variable →
`~/.dsh/cuda.json` → built-in discovery.

| Environment variable | Meaning | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `DSH_CUDA_PYTHON` | interpreter to use | discovered |
| `DSH_CUDA_RUNS_DIR` | where job directories live | `~/.dsh/gpu-runs` |
| `DSH_CUDA_TIMEOUT_MS` | foreground budget | `300000` |
| `DSH_CUDA_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS` | ceiling for a caller-supplied budget | `1800000` |
| `DSH_CUDA_MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS` | output returned to the model per stream | `12000` |

`~/.dsh/cuda.json` is the convenient place for a machine-specific interpreter (an embedded
Python, a conda env):

```json
{
  "pythonPath": "C:\\path\\to\\python.exe",
  "pythonCandidates": ["C:\\path\\to\\python.exe"],
  "runsDir": "D:\\gpu-runs"
}
```

A malformed file is ignored rather than fatal.

### Interpreter discovery

With nothing configured, the plugin probes every `python`/`python3` on `PATH` and a few
usual install locations, then picks the first candidate that exists. `cuda_status` reports
what each one can actually do (`torch` version, CUDA availability, device name, bf16), and
the probe result is cached for an hour.

An interpreter only counts if it has `torch` **with CUDA**. A system Python without torch
is reported but never chosen. Embedded interpreters shipped with image-generation tools
(ComfyUI, Stable Diffusion WebUI) work well — point `DSH_CUDA_PYTHON` at them.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness, Node 22+
- **Any** CUDA-capable NVIDIA GPU — the card model does not matter, and nothing here is tuned for
  one. `cuda_status` reports the model, memory, compute capability and bf16 support at runtime, so
  the documents deliberately do not hard-code them.
- **The one real constraint is driver ↔ torch.** A CUDA build of PyTorch needs a driver at least as
  new as the CUDA runtime it was compiled against; if `torch.cuda.is_available()` is `False`, that
  mismatch (or a CPU-only torch wheel) is the usual cause. `cuda_status` shows the driver and each
  interpreter's CUDA availability side by side, so the problem is visible before writing any code.
- A Python with `torch` + CUDA. The rest (numpy, triton, scipy…) is optional.

For **writing custom kernels** the plugin's skill documents what actually works: use
[`triton`](https://github.com/triton-lang/triton) if it is installed. `numba.cuda` needs
`libNVVM` (shipped with the CUDA Toolkit) and fails with
`NvvmSupportError: libNVVM cannot be found` when the Toolkit is absent — a common trap.

## Tests

110 checks across three suites. All of them run with plain Node — no harness restart, no
test framework:

```bash
node test/selftest.mjs    # 36  engine, against the real GPU
node test/harness.mjs     # 46  plugin: mock context drives apply(), then the tools run
node test/lossless.mjs    # 28  every tool value crosses the wire (see below)
```

- `selftest.mjs` covers both run modes, promotion, cancellation, log tails, artifact
  collection and argument validation on real hardware.
- `harness.mjs` builds a fake cordis context with exactly the surface the plugin uses, so
  `apply()` and every tool branch are exercised without the harness.
- `lossless.mjs` deserves its own line: DSH refuses a tool value that is not lossless JSON
  (`visitJsonValue` in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-gateway` rejects `undefined`, `NaN`, `-0`,
  class instances, array holes and cycles). A single `undefined` field is enough to make a
  perfectly working tool answer `value is not lossless JSON`, and no mock-based test
  catches it. The suite reimplements that rule verbatim and adds six deliberately broken
  values to prove the check itself has teeth.

## Known limits

- **Windows/WDDM**: `nvidia-smi` reports no per-process VRAM and mixes graphics processes
  into the GPU process list. `cuda_status` says so rather than pretending otherwise.
- **Concurrency**: `cuda_run` is registered as not concurrency-safe, so the harness will not
  overlap two runs; large concurrent jobs would compete for VRAM anyway.
- **No CUDA Toolkit integration**: `nvcc` is never invoked. Everything runs through the
  interpreter, which keeps the plugin zero-install.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: 峰谷倒计时：在 DSH 模型名称中显示 DeepSeek 峰谷状态与倒计时，支持实时预览与紧凑设置。
plugins.readme_text: # 峰谷倒计时 独立插件 **dsh-liao-peakclock**，当前版本 **0.1.1**，适配 **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2**。 在原生模型选择器中显示 `DS4.1F · 谷 2:30 · High`。峰时用琥珀色，谷时用青绿色；倒计时为小时:分钟，完整型号保留在悬停提示中。 ## 截图 桌面 DSH 中的实际模型按钮： 峰时与谷时的显示效果： 设置页包含当前状态、时间轴、显示偏好及可折叠的计费说明： 后两张截图来自插件独立预览，使用示例模型和时间；展示的是实际插件组件，按三倍分辨率渲染，点击可查看高清原图。 ## 安装 在 DSH 插件页选择“添加插件”，输入： ```text github:oliblue-evan/dsh-liao-peakclock ``` 或使用 CLI（将 `desktop` 换成自己的 Profile 名称）： ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:oliblue-evan/dsh-liao-peakclock ``` 仓库包含预构建产物，安装时无需编译源码。仅声明支持 DSH **0.2.0-rc.2**；其他版本须先核验兼容性。目前未发布 npm 包。 ## 使用 打开“插件 → 峰谷倒计时”： - 当前状态：峰/谷、秒级倒计时、下次切换时间和今日 24 小时时段轴。 - 显示偏好：常用选项与峰／谷双状态预览并排，短选项使用分段按钮，无系统下拉菜单；更多显示选项默认折叠。三套预设保留总开关、来源范围和提前时间。 - 倒计时：始终、临近切换或关闭；临近模式可提前 30／60 分钟显示，设置页仍保留完整的实时倒计时。 - 生效范围：所有可识别的 DeepSeek 模型，或仅 DSH 官方账号与官方 API 来源；第三方渠道不视为官方计费。 - 价格与规则：按需展开官方 API 的人民币价格快照、计费解释、峰谷规则与日历来源。 模型识别优先读取当前输入框所属会话的模型 ID；带渠道前缀和自定义显示名也可识别。ID 尚不可用时才以名称兜底。多个会话分别绑定各自输入框，不读取全局默认模型替代会话状态。 模型名称处通常按分钟刷新；设置页打开时共享时钟切换为秒级，关闭后恢复分钟级。页面隐藏时暂停前台时钟，唤醒时重新读取系统时间。 ## 时段与计费参考 北京时间，周一至周五 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00 为峰时，不含中国法定节假日；其余时间、周末和法定节假日全天为谷时，调休周末仍按谷时。 这里提供的是 [DeepSeek 官方时段与价格](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing/) 参考；第三方渠道可能有不同倍率、套餐和计费规则，以渠道账单为准。插件不读取 API 密钥、不查询余额、不修改模型或实际扣费。 价格为 2026-10-15 核对的静态快照，附官方最新价格链接，不假称实时同步。节假日日历沿用上游的验证逻辑，临近年末或缺少年份时从固定 holiday-cn 数据源尝试补充；无法确定下一次切换时明确显示“待核实”。 ## 从旧版迁移 该独立包不会占用或修改原版 dsh-timeband 的包名、Loader ID 或样式所有权。 首次运行优先读取自己的存储；若尚无数据，会先尝试迁移独立试用版，再尝试迁移原本 `dsh-timeband` 的显示偏好、节假日日历和日历检查记录。旧数据保留；已有设置不会被旧数据覆盖。旧提醒、音效、弹出时间轴和更新检查不再包含在本包中。 安装新包前停用旧包，避免两套显示同时运行。建议保留旧包和 Profile 配置备份以便回滚。无需更改 DSH 宿主源码。 ## 开发与检查 Node.js 22+，npm： ```sh npm ci --ignore-scripts npm run compatibility npm run typecheck npm run build npm test npm run test:browser npm pack --ignore-scripts npm run test:artifact -- ./dsh-liao-peakclock-0.1.1.tgz ``` `compatibility` 仅核验精确目标 0.2.0-rc.2，不追随 npm latest，也不修改宿主。 `npm run preview` 提供仅浏览器使用的回归夹具：加载实际构建产物，以模拟会话验证别名、切换、开关、时间边界和卸载。它不是 DSH Web 实例，不读取真实 Profile、账号或对话。浏览器测试使用这一夹具；真实 SlotRegistry 生命周期和多会话隔离另有构建产物/DOM 测试。 客户端以 ModuleLoader 格式构建，运行时仅由宿主提供 React。模型身份来自公开的会话级 ModelDirectory；原生 ModelSelect 没有导出替换组件，因此显示层仍使用针对 rc.2 控件结构的窄范围 DOM 适配。它保留 React 原节点与原生事件，仅增加自有显示节点，禁用或卸载时恢复。宿主升级后需要重新核验控件结构；无法匹配的控件保留原生显示。 ## 来源与许可 派生自 [dsh-timeband v1.3.4](https://github.com/a961282799-crypto/dsh-timeband)，保留其节假日与时段基础逻辑，并重做显示、设置、会话绑定和验证流程。这是独立维护的衍生插件。 MIT，原版权和许可全文保留在 LICENSE；来源记录见 NOTICE。

plugins.description: Ship a local DSH plugin project to GitHub and the plugin market in one call: preflight, per-file upload with byte verification, the market registry PR, then pull every published file back and compare bytes.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-slipway（滑道）

**把本地 DSH 插件工程一条命令发到 GitHub、再开一条市场收录 PR，最后把线上文件逐个拉回来比 sha256。**

> 名字的来由：船造好了得从滑道下水。前面三个作品每发一次，我都要手写同一串脚本 ——
> 建仓库 → 逐文件 PUT（还要比字节数）→ 打 topic → fork 建分支 → 写登记 yml → 开 PR →
> 线上逐文件回拉核对。三遍下来每次都掉同一个坑。这活该由代码干。

---

## 它做什么

**适用范围（一句话）：只走 GitHub。** 仓库建在 GitHub、文件传到 GitHub、市场收录 PR 也开在 GitHub 上。
**GitLab / Gitee / npm 都没有适配** —— 想发到别的平台，得先有那条平台的 API 与 token（见「已知限制」）。

一次调用走完四个阶段，每个阶段都留下可核对的证据：

| 阶段 | 做什么 | 证据 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **① 自检** | 读 `package.json`、按 `files` 白名单收集文件、查 `main`/`exports`/`dsh.bundle.patch` 是否落地、扫密钥 | 文件数、总字节、错误/提醒清单 |
| **② 仓库** | 有就复用、没有就建（`auto_init:false`） | 仓库 URL、默认分支 |
| **③ 上传** | 逐文件 PUT（带 sha 的更新式写入），然后设 topics | 每个文件的字节数与 blob 短 sha |
| **④ 市场 PR** | fork（若无）→ 从上游 head 建分支 → 写 `data/plugins/<owner>__<repo>.yml` → 开 PR | PR 号与状态（已有 PR 就报它的号，不重复开） |
| **⑤ 回验** | 把线上每个文件拉回来，与本地比 **sha256 与长度** | 「N 个文件线上字节与本地完全一致」 |

## 安全边界（代码里的边界，不是口头承诺）

- **默认 dry-run**：不显式传 `dryRun: false`（CLI 是 `--go`）就只演算、只报告，**一根手指都不动远端**。
- **目标必须显式给**：`projectDir`（绝对路径）/ `repo` / `category` / `descriptionEn` / `descriptionZh` 缺一不可。
  解析不出来就**报错**，绝不从当前目录、包名或相似度去猜。
- **owner 与 token 必须对得上**：token 属于别人 —— 直接停，不做任何请求。
- **token 永不进输出**：只出现 `ghp_****(40)` 这样的掩码；请求证据里只记方法与路径，**不记 body**。
- **密钥扫描在自检里**：命中 `sk-…` / `ghp_…` / 私钥块等即**阻断发布**，且只报文件:行号与掩码，**不回显明文**。
- **幂等**：仓库、分支、PR 都先查再说；重复跑不会造出第二条。
- **活代码树警告**：工程若被 profile 的 junction 挂载（即"活代码"），报告里会出现 `live-tree` 提醒 ——
  **发布可以，测试绝对不许在那里跑**（把副本复制到沙箱再跑）。

## 安装

市场收录后：在 DSH 里搜 `dsh-slipway` 安装即可。手动安装：

```powershell
# 1) 建目录链接（junction 不需要管理员）
New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-slipway" -Target "D:\dsh\projects\dsh-slipway"
# 2) profile 的 package.json：dependencies 加 "dsh-slipway": "link:D:/dsh/projects/dsh-slipway"
#    **同时**加进 dsh.profile.bundles（漏了就不加载）
# 3) 重启 DSH
```

## 用法

### 作为工具（Agent 用）

```
slipway_publish   projectDir=… repo=… category=tools descriptionEn=… descriptionZh=… [dryRun]
slipway_verify    projectDir=… repo=… owner=…
```

典型流程：先 `dryRun` 跑一次 → 把报告给人看 → 得到许可 → `dryRun: false`。

### 作为命令（不开会话也能发）

```powershell
# 只自检（只读）
dsh-slipway plan    --project D:\dsh\projects\dsh-slipway --repo dsh-slipway --category tools --desc-en "…" --desc-zh "…"

# dry-run（默认）
dsh-slipway publish --project … --repo … --category tools --desc-en "…" --desc-zh "…"

# 真跑
dsh-slipway publish --project … --repo … --category tools --desc-en "…" --desc-zh "…" --go

# 只回验
dsh-slipway verify  --project … --repo … --owner 7gzgn
```

退出码：`0` 成功 / `0` dry-run 通过；`1` 有阻断；`2` 用法错误。

### PAT 从哪来

依次找：`--token-file` → 环境变量 `DSH_SLIPWAY_TOKEN_FILE` → `~/.dsh/.gh-token` → `D:\dsh\.gh-token`。
需要的 scope：`repo`（建仓库、推文件、开 PR）。

### 市场分类白名单

`agi ui usage theme model identity session memory tools wsl browser vision voice docs skill workflow git notify dev security remote market fun`

## 兼容性

- 运行时：**DSH 0.2.0-rc.2**（本人实测使用的版本）。
- `peerDependencies` 用显式范围（`>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`），下限是实测过的版本，上限不赌没验证过的 breaking change。
- **运行时主动降级**：拿不到 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 的 `defineTool` → 退化成恒等函数（CLI 与测试场景照常工作）；
  `ctx.systemPrompt` 不存在 → 跳过公告段。宿主 API 有出入时，本插件少一项能力，而不是把 DSH 拖崩。

## 已知边界

- **单文件 ≤ 25MB**：contents API 走不了更大的文件（那需要 Git Data API，v0.1 不做）；>1MB 会给提醒。
- **不做 npm 发布**：DSH 市场大半靠 `github:owner/repo` 安装，npm 不在链路上。
- **不替你跑项目的测试**：测试要不要跑、在哪跑由调用方决定（活代码树里跑测试 = 在真宿主上生效，这是血换来的规矩）。
- **不自动写简介**：市场条目上的中英文简介必须由人给 —— 自动生成的是"看起来像"的话。

## 自测

```powershell
node test/smoke.mjs   # 56 项，全用假 GitHub，不碰网络、不碰宿主
```

测试开头有一道**活代码树自检**：发现自己在 `profiles/*/node_modules` 挂着的工程里跑，就直接 `exit 2`。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: 多轮迭代深度检索插件（DeepSeek Harness）：14 平台定向 · 来源可信度分级 A/B/C/D · 交叉验证 · 虚假信息检测 | Multi-round iterative deep-research for DSH
plugins.readme_text:
[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@xiaowuwu/dsh-deep-search)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@xiaowuwu/dsh-deep-search)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@xiaowuwu/dsh-deep-search)](./LICENSE)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-%3E%3D0.2.0--rc.2-brightgreen)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai)

# dsh-deep-search

> **Stop letting your DSH agent conclude from a single search.**
> Multi-round iterative deep research · 14 platform-targeted retrievers · A/B/C/D source grading · cross-validation · misinformation heuristics.

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@xiaowuwu/dsh-deep-search)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@xiaowuwu/dsh-deep-search)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@xiaowuwu/dsh-deep-search)](./LICENSE)

A one-shot `web_search` answering "has model X shipped?" — with an aggregator's clickbait headline — is how hallucinated facts get into your context.

**dsh-deep-search** makes the *plan → parallel-retrieve → parse → rewrite → verify* loop the **default behavior** of a DSH session. The intelligence is your session model; the grunt work (dedup, clustering, trust grading, rumor flags) is the plugin. Zero forced payments: no API key needed for the core platforms; quota-exhausted engines fall to the back of the chain and self-heal.

中文 README：[README.md](./README.md)

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-deep-search
# restart DSH (the web profile disables HMR)
```

Then just ask: *"Has Qwen4-Max actually been released?"* — the model auto-loads the deep-research protocol and iterates until it finds A-grade official evidence or honestly reports **not found**.

## What you get

| | |
|---|---|
| 🔁 Default iteration | System-prompt injection + SKILL: time-sensitive / contested questions iterate up to 5 rounds without being asked |
| 🌐 14 platforms | GitHub · HuggingFace · ModelScope · Zhihu · Reddit · HackerNews · StackOverflow · Wikipedia · V2EX · npm · bilibili · Weibo · X (best-effort) · free general engines (Bing/DDG/SearXNG/Mojeek/Firecrawl) |
| 🧮 Trust grades | A official announcement → B official interaction → C community (needs cross-validation) → D media/unknown. Data-driven, user-extensible |
| 🕵️ Rumor detection | content-farm / clickbait / satire / single-source / date-conflict / stale flags, automatic |
| 🔗 Cross-validation matrix | Same-event clustering + independent-domain counting kills "3 reprints ≠ 3 sources" |
| 🚫 Honest degradation | X/Weibo/bilibili anti-bot failures surface as `gaps` with `unavailable/degraded` — web substitutes are never presented as X coverage |
| 📄 "Not found" discipline | When nothing confirms: coverage + graded clues + explicitly *"this does not mean it did not happen"* |
| 💸 No paid walls | Optional keyed engines (Tavily/Serper/Bocha/Exa/Firecrawl) activate only when credentials resolve; free channels cover the default flow |

## Tools

```jsonc
deep_search({ question, queries: [ "…", { q, target, timeRange } ], researchId, budgetChars })
// → results[trustRank, flags, extracted] · clusters · gaps · officialConfirmation · hint · stats
deep_search({ doctor: true })            // zero-quota readiness of every channel
research_state({ researchId, action })   // summary / close / reset — the citation matrix
verify_claims({ researchId, claims })    // evidence match + rule-suggested verdict
```

## Architecture

Four roles — the model plans/parses/rewrites/adjudicates; the plugin executes, dedups, clusters, grades, budgets, and reports honestly. See [SKILL.md](assets/skills/dsh-deep-search/SKILL.md) for the full protocol.

## Compared to

- **dsh-web-search-pro**: heavy search infra (cache/evidence-packs/browser); iteration protocol left to you.
- **dsh-free-search**: 19 keyless engines + image wall, single round.
- **dsh-zhihu-search**: single-platform official-API specialist.
- **modsearch**: keyless web/X bridge (X needs local Grok), single shot.

## 中文说明

# dsh-deep-search

> **让你的 DSH 不再一次搜索就下结论。**
> 多轮迭代深度检索 · 14 平台定向 · 来源可信度分级 (A/B/C/D) · 交叉验证 · 虚假信息检测


一次 `web_search` 就回答"XX 发布了没有"？模型把聚合站的标题党当成事实、把"没搜到"说成"不存在"？

**dsh-deep-search** 把「查询规划 → 并行检索 → 解析 → 重写 → 验证分级」这套多轮迭代协议变成 DSH 会话的默认行为。智能由你的会话模型驱动，苦力由插件承担——去重、聚类、可信度分级、虚假信号检测全部自动完成。全程零强制付费依赖：不配任何 API Key 也能跑满核心平台，配额耗尽的引擎自动退避到链尾并自愈。

English README: [README.en.md](./README.en.md)

## 快速上手

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-deep-search
# 重启 DSH（web profile 关闭了 HMR）
```

装好后直接问：「Qwen4-Max 到底发布了吗？」——会话模型会自动加载 deep-research 协议，多轮迭代直到拿到官方 A 级证据或如实报告"未检索到"。

## 核心能力

| | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 🔁 迭代协议默认化 | 系统提示注入 + SKILL：时效/真伪问题自动走多轮（≤5 轮），无需用户催 |
| 🌐 14 平台定向检索 | GitHub · HuggingFace · ModelScope · 知乎 · Reddit · HN · StackOverflow · Wikipedia · V2EX · npm · B站 · 微博 · X(尽力而为) · + 免Key通用引擎(Bing/DDG/SearXNG/Mojeek/Firecrawl) |
| 🧮 可信度分级 A/B/C/D | 官方公告 > 官方互动 > 社区(需交叉验证) > 媒体/未知。数据驱动规则表可扩 |
| 🕵️ 虚假信息信号 | 内容农场 / 标题党 / 讽刺源 / 孤证 / 日期矛盾 / 旧闻 自动打标 |
| 🔗 交叉验证矩阵 | 同事件多源聚类 + 独立域名计数，杜绝"3 家转载当 3 个信源" |
| 🚫 诚实降级 | X/微博/B站 反爬失败 → gaps 明示 `unavailable/degraded`，web 替代绝不冒充 X 覆盖 |
| 📄 "未检索到"纪律 | 找不到时输出：覆盖范围 + 现有线索分级 + "这不等于不存在" |
| 💸 零强制付费 | Keyed 引擎(Tavily/Serper/博查/Exa/Firecrawl-Key)有免费额度，配置了才启用，缺失自动禁用并在 doctor 说明 |

## 三个工具

```jsonc
// 主力：并行检索 + 跨轮去重 + 自动分级
deep_search({
  question: "Qwen4-Max 发布了吗",
  queries: [
    "Qwen4-Max released open weights",
    { q: "\"Qwen4-Max\"", target: "huggingface", timeRange: "week" },
    { q: "from:Alibaba_Qwen Qwen4", target: "x" }
  ],
  researchId: "rs-xxxx" // 续轮，自动只回新增
})
// → { results[trustRank/flags/extracted], clusters, gaps, officialConfirmation, hint, … }

// 交叉验证矩阵 + 轮次历史，写最终答案前先读
research_state({ researchId: "rs-xxxx", action: "summary" })

// 断言 ↔ 已收集证据核对（不再联网），给裁决建议
verify_claims({ researchId: "rs-xxxx", claims: [{ text: "Qwen4-Max 2026-10-10 开源" }] })

// 零配额自检：各引擎/平台就绪、缺哪些可选凭据、谁在冷却
deep_search({ doctor: true })
```

## 架构：四模块，智能在模型、苦力在插件

```
你(规划器) ──生成 10-20 组查询──▶ deep_search(执行器：并行/去重/聚类/分级/预算)
     ▲                                          │
     └──解析+重写：读 extracted 实体 + hint◀────┘
               │ 找到 A 级公告 | 轮次尽 | 无新词
               ▼
        research_state(交叉验证矩阵) ──▶ 你(验证器)生成分级答案
```

## 对比：我该装哪个？

| 插件 | 定位 |
|---|---|
| **dsh-deep-search** | **多轮迭代协议** + 平台定向 + A/B/C/D 分级 + 虚假信息检测；不替代内置 web_search，而是给它装上"查证"的肌肉记忆 |
| dsh-web-search-pro | 重型检索基础设施（缓存/证据包/浏览器渲染），单次检索很强，迭代协议需自配 |
| dsh-free-search | 19 引擎免Key兜底 + 图片墙，广度好，单轮 |
| dsh-zhihu-search | 知乎官方 API 单平台专家 |
| modsearch | 免Key网页/X 桥接（X 需本机 Grok），单次检索 |

它们共存不冲突：本插件自带引擎层，不 override `ctx.web` seam，工具名独立。

## 配置

全部字段可经 DSH 设置页 → 插件 → dsh-deep-search 修改；API Key 一律走 DSH 凭据存储，配置里只存引用名：

```jsonc
{
  "enabledEngines": ["bing", "ddg", "searxng", "mojeek", "firecrawl-keyless", "tavily"],
  "enabledPlatforms": ["github", "huggingface", "modelscope", "reddit", "hackernews", "zhihu", "x"],
  "proxy": "", "proxyByTarget": { "x": "http://127.0.0.1:7890" },
  "concurrency": 8, "maxRounds": 5, "budgetChars": 9000,
  "promptInjection": true
}
```

可选凭据（缺了不影响默认流程）：`TAVILY_API_KEY` · `SERPER_API_KEY` · `BOCHA_API_KEY` · `EXA_API_KEY` · `FIRECRAWL_API_KEY` · `ZHIHU_ACCESS_SECRET`（知乎升稳定档）· `ROLLI_API_TOKEN`（X 升稳定档）。

## 开发

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test   # 98 项测试，无需网络
pnpm run build                    # tsc 类型检查 + tsdown 打包 lib/
```

plugins.description: Desktop mode for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: sessions as movable windows with a taskbar (experimental)
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-desktop-ui

**Desktop mode** for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI. Keep the sidebar exactly as it
is, and turn the conversation area into a desktop where every session is a
movable, resizable window — with a taskbar along the bottom.

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-desktop-ui.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-desktop-ui)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](./LICENSE)

- **Source code:** [github.com/mrbeandev/dsh-desktop-ui](https://github.com/mrbeandev/dsh-desktop-ui)
- **npm package:** [npmjs.com/package/dsh-desktop-ui](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-desktop-ui)

**Contents:** [Why](#why-this-plugin-exists) · [Install](#install-from-npm) ·
[Features](#features) · [Compatibility](#compatibility-and-limitations) ·
[Development](#build-and-test) · [Local setup](./LOCAL-SETUP.md) · [Release checklist](./RELEASE.md)

![Four sessions from different workspaces tiled on the desktop](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrbeandev/dsh-desktop-ui/main/assets/showcase/tiled-light.webp)

## Why this plugin exists

DSH shows one conversation at a time. When you juggle several sessions — a long
agent run, a quick question, a code review — you keep clicking back and forth in
the sidebar. Desktop mode lets you keep them all on screen at once, arrange them
side by side, and park the rest in a taskbar.

## Install from npm

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-desktop-ui
```

Restart `dsh web` when asked, then refresh the DSH page. A **Desktop mode** switch
appears in the sidebar, directly above **Settings**.

To remove:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-desktop-ui
```

Restart and refresh. The normal conversation view comes back unchanged; only the
browser-local window layout remains in `localStorage`.

## Features

| Feature | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Desktop mode switch** | Sits directly above Settings. Off by default; the choice persists in this browser. Turning it off returns to the normal conversation on the focused window's session. |
| **Sessions as windows** | Clicking a session in the sidebar opens it as a window. A session can only have one window — clicking it again restores and focuses the existing one. Every window shows the **same conversation UI as the main chat** — header, view tabs, transcript, composer, and anything other plugins add (for example `dsh-rewind-plugin`'s rewind button under your messages). |
| **Window titles** | Every title bar reads `workspace | session` (for example `acme-web | Fix flaky checkout test`), with the workspace name in a quieter colour. Ungrouped sessions show just the session title. The full label is also the window's tooltip and accessible name. |
| **Find it in the sidebar** | Hovering a window highlights its session and its workspace in the sidebar. If that workspace is collapsed, it opens while you hover and closes again when you move away (unless you clicked in the sidebar meanwhile). Turn this off in **Plugins → dsh-desktop-ui → Highlight the sidebar on hover**; the choice is saved with the layout. |
| **Taskbar tooltips** | Hovering (or keyboard-focusing) a taskbar button shows `workspace | session`, plus "minimized" or "popped out" when it applies. |
| **Wallpaper and transparency** | **Plugins → dsh-desktop-ui → Desktop background** has a live preview. **Wallpaper**: PNG, WebP, GIF, JPEG, AVIF or SVG, up to 12 MB, with Fill / Fit / Center / Tile; transparent pixels in the image show the theme colour. **Wallpaper opacity** blends the image into the theme colour. **Canvas opacity** is how much of the theme-coloured canvas covers the wallpaper (0% = wallpaper fully visible, 100% = hidden); without a wallpaper it makes the empty desktop see-through to what is behind it. **Taskbar opacity** turns the taskbar into frosted glass below 100%. Windows always stay solid. Choosing a first wallpaper sets canvas opacity to 0% so the image is visible right away. **Reset appearance** restores the defaults. |
| **Window controls** | Drag the title bar to move; drag any edge or corner to resize; double-click the title to maximize/restore; minimize, maximize and close buttons. |
| **Pop out (browser only)** | The ↗ button left of minimize opens that session in its own browser window, showing just that conversation (no sidebar). The desktop keeps a placeholder with **Pop back in**; the popout window has a **Pop back in** button in its header too. Either one closes the popout and returns the session to the canvas. Closing the popout window yourself also brings it back. The button is hidden in the DeepSeek desktop app, which is detected through the `data-platform` marker its preload sets on `<html>` (the same signal DSH's shortcut layer uses). |
| **Linked borders** | When windows sit side by side or stacked (for example after Tile or Side by side, or a left/right snap), dragging the border between them resizes all of them at once: as one grows, its neighbour shrinks, and the gap stays the same. In a grid the whole straight split moves together. It stops at each window's minimum size. Corner grips and windows that don't touch still resize on their own. |
| **Snapping** | Drag a window to the left or right edge to fill that half, or to the top to maximize. |
| **Taskbar** | New session button, one button per window (click to focus, click the focused one to minimize, a dot shows running sessions), Cascade / Tile / Side-by-side layouts, a clock, and a Show desktop strip at the far right. |
| **Window text size** | Window contents are the stock UI scaled down uniformly (default 85%), so every element — including ones added by other plugins — shrinks together. Click the percentage in the taskbar to make it larger, right-click to make it smaller (70–100%). The normal full-width conversation is untouched. |
| **Restored after restart** | Desktop mode, the open windows, their positions and sizes, minimized/maximized state, stacking order and text size are saved to your DSH profile config and restored after you stop and restart DSH — even in a different browser. Windows you closed stay closed. |
| **Plays well with sidebar plugins** | The Desktop mode switch is always the top entry above Settings; other footer buttons (for example `dsh-all-usage`) stack underneath it instead of being pushed sideways. |
| **Light and dark** | Uses DSH's own theme tokens only, so it follows the GUI theme automatically. |
| **Narrow screens** | Below 720px the focused window fills the canvas and you switch through the taskbar. |

The wallpaper image itself never leaves the browser: it is kept in IndexedDB (database `dsh-desktop-ui`), not in the profile config, so it is not synced to other browsers. Only its settings (on/off, layout, strength, file name) are.

Closing a window never deletes or archives a session. The layout is stored as one
small JSON value in this plugin's own config entry (`dsh-desktop-ui` → `layout` in
your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`), written through DSH's settings service, with a
browser `localStorage` copy (`dsh-desktop-ui.state.v1`) for instant reloads. It
contains session ids, geometry and flags only — never conversation content,
credentials or prompts. The plugin makes no network requests of its own. To reset
the desktop, remove the `layout` line or switch Desktop mode off and close the windows.

![Dark theme](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrbeandev/dsh-desktop-ui/main/assets/showcase/tiled-dark.webp)

![Dragging a window to the right edge shows the snap preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrbeandev/dsh-desktop-ui/main/assets/showcase/snap-preview.webp)

![A session popped out: the canvas keeps a Pop back in placeholder](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrbeandev/dsh-desktop-ui/main/assets/showcase/popout-canvas.webp)

![The popout browser window shows just that conversation, with Pop back in in its header](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrbeandev/dsh-desktop-ui/main/assets/showcase/popout-window.webp)

## Compatibility and limitations

**Requires DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`.** Tested on DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 with Node 24.

This is an **internal integration**, not a stable public DSH API. It plugs into:

| Seam | Use |
|---|---|
| `main` keyed

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-find-viewer

A find bar for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar's text preview, added to the document
toolbar the preview already has. It searches the file, shows the match count, highlights
the hits, and jumps between them.

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

![The find bar over a Markdown preview, with the current hit in orange](assets/find-bar.png)

![The find bar: input, count, previous/next, match case, whole word, close](assets/find-bar-closeup.png)

## What it does

- **A magnifier button in the document toolbar**, next to *Open in app*. It appears only
  while the pane shows a text file, so PDF, image, HTML, spreadsheet and Office previews
  keep their toolbar unchanged.
- **A find bar** with an input, `n/m` count, previous/next, match case (`Aa`), whole word
  (`W`) and close. `Enter` goes to the next hit, `Shift+Enter` to the previous one, `Esc`
  closes.
- **`Cmd/Ctrl+F`** opens it while the preview is the pane you last clicked in.
- **Search a selection**: select text in the preview, then open the bar — the selection
  becomes the keyword. A multi-line selection uses its first line; a selection longer than
  200 characters is ignored.
- **Hits are highlighted in the colours Edge and Chrome use for find-on-page**: yellow
  `#FFFF00` for hits, orange `#FF9632` for the current one, black text on both. Typing a
  keyword scrolls to the first hit.

## Match counts

| Preview | Counts | Jump | Highlight |
|---|---|---|---|
| Plain text, code | Whole file, exact | Any line, including lines the viewer has not loaded yet | Every rendered hit |
| Markdown | The text currently rendered | Every rendered hit | Every rendered hit |

Markdown differs because the official Markdown view renders formatted HTML: source
markers are gone and it exposes no per-line anchors, so a find bar over it can only count
and jump within what is rendered — the count grows as more of the document loads. Plain
text and code keep their source lines in the DOM, so those two count the whole file.

Files the bar covers: Markdown (`.md`, `.markdown`, `.mdx`), plain text and logs, and code
(`.js`, `.ts`, `.py`, `.go`, `.rs`, `.java`, `.c`, `.cpp`, `.css`, `.json`, `.yaml`,
`.toml`, `.sh`, `.sql`, and more). Spreadsheets (`.csv`, `.tsv`), HTML and SVG keep their
own previews. A file with no suffix, such as `Dockerfile`, is not covered, because the
viewer picks renderers by file suffix.

## Install

From the npm registry:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-find-viewer
```

Straight from GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Makk9609/dsh-find-viewer
```

Then restart `dsh web`. Alternatively install it from the Plugin Market or the Plugin
Manager, which also enables the bundle for you.

Remove it with:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-find-viewer
```

## How it works

The plugin has no build step and no runtime dependencies. Its browser half registers one
entry in the document toolbar's additive list slot
(`sidebar.right.tab.document.actions`), a slot that only appends, so no existing control is
replaced.

- Whole-file counting reads the file with the harness's own paged file Remote
  (`remote.workspaceFiles.read`), which is the same reader the preview itself uses.
- Highlights use the CSS Custom Highlight API: the bar registers ranges and never edits
  the DOM the official renderers own.
- Jumping to a line the viewer has not loaded yet asks the sidebar to navigate to that line
  (`sidebarRight.openResource`), which makes the viewer load the pages it needs.
- Locale lookups go through the client locale service (English and Chinese dictionaries are
  included).

It imports no harness client package as a module and registers no global keyboard handler;
`Cmd/Ctrl+F` is only intercepted while the preview is the pane you last clicked in.

## Limits

- The whole-file scan covers the first 20,000 lines or 4 MiB, whichever comes first; the
  find bar says so when a file is larger. Up to 3,000 hits are painted, and up to 50,000 are
  counted (`50000+` beyond that).
- Highlights need the CSS Custom Highlight API (Chromium 105+, Safari 17.2+, Firefox 140+).
  Where it is missing, counts and jumps still work and hits are not painted.
- Matches do not span lines.
- Verified against DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`. The plugin declares no `engines.dsh`
  range because its compatibility with later versions has not been tested.

## Development

```sh
npm test        # loads the browser half with stubs, then checks matching, address
                # decoding, the registration shape and the emitted highlight rules
```

`client.js` is the whole browser half and `index.js` is an empty host half, which exists so
the loader carries the package.
